question: How do I set up AutoInvest for Stocks?
answer: - To set up AutoInvest in stocks, you'll need an active Stocks account. - Log in to Trust App and go to Investments - Tap Stocks tab - Tap Set up to schedule AutoInvest now - Choose the stock or ETF you want to AutoInvest in - Select your preferred frequency and start date , otherwise the default would be the next business day - Enter the amount and currency to invest regularly - Review and confirm your setup

question: Can I set up more than one AutoInvest schedule for Stocks?
answer: - Yes, you can create multiple AutoInvest instructions - even more than one for the same stock or ETF with different frequency. You can edit or cancel them any time from the next scheduled date.

question: Do I need to fund my Stocks account before each AutoInvest schedule?
answer: - No, you do not need to separately fund your Stocks account. Money will be automatically deducted from your Trust Savings account in SGD and converted to USD at the prevailing exchange rate for each scheduled AutoInvest buy order. You’ll be notified about your upcoming AutoInvest order 1 day in advance. Please ensure you have sufficient monies in your Savings account.

question: What happens if I have insufficient money in my Savings account for the AutoInvest schedule?
answer: - If your Savings account doesn’t have sufficient monies, your AutoInvest for that scheduled date will not go through, and you’ll be notified. There won’t be a retry for that particular scheduled date, but you can still invest by topping up your Stocks account and then placing an order through the Trust App. As long as your AutoInvest setup remains active, it will automatically try again during the next scheduled date.

question: What happens if my AutoInvest date falls on a non-trading day?
answer: - If your scheduled AutoInvest date falls on a non-trading day, our system will reschedule it to the next available trading day. The autoinvested amount will be deducted from your savings account, and the market buy order will be submitted on the next available trading day. To view the list of non-trading days, please refer to Holidays & Trading Hours

question: What happens if I have insufficient money in my Savings account for the AutoInvest schedule?
answer: - If your Savings account doesn’t have sufficient monies, your AutoInvest for that scheduled date will not go through, and you’ll be notified. There won’t be a retry for that particular scheduled date, but you can still invest by topping up your Stocks account and then placing an order through the Trust App. As long as your AutoInvest setup remains active, it will automatically try again during the next scheduled date.

question: When will my physical card arrive?
answer: - Your physical card will be delivered to you within 6-7 working days from your application date.

question: What is the difference between the physical card and digital card only?
answer: - You can perform almost all card related transactions in Singapore using digital card through Apple Pay, Google Pay and FairPrice App.

question: What can I use my digital card for?
answer: - Your digital card can be used for online transactions, in-app purchases, offline and recurring payments (e.g. insurance policy premiums, telecommunications bills). If you have enrolled your card for Apple Pay and/or Google Pay, you may use them for in-store purchases.

question: How do I add my card into Apple Pay and Google Pay?
answer: - a. To add your card to Apple Pay : - Log into your Trust app - Tap "View Card" - Tap “Add to Apple Wallet” - Follow the on-screen instructions b. To add your card to Google Wallet or Google Pay: - Log into your Trust app - Tap "View Card" - Tap “Add to Google Pay” - Follow the on-screen instructions

question: If I am a Union member, how do I receive my FairPrice Member benefits of 4% with the digital card?
answer: - You can earn the 4% FairPrice Member benefits by adding your digital card in the FairPrice app and using your FairPrice app to make payment in-store or online.

question: How can I add my card to the FairPrice App?
answer: - Follow these steps: - Download the FairPrice App from App Store / Play Store - Click on the icon on the top left corner of the main screen - Tap on Credit/Debit Card - Tap on + Add payment Method - Log into your Trust App, copy your card number using the copy icon . Remember your CVV and card expiry - Enter your card details manually and click on add card

question: How can I track the delivery status of my physical card?
answer: - You can track the delivery status of your physical card in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Tap on 'Savings' 3. Select 'Track Your Physical Card' section

question: In the App, the "Track your Physical Card" states delivered, However I did not receive the card.
answer: - Reach us via: - Live chat or voice call on your Trust App - OR call us at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 )

question: Why do I need to activate my new physical card before use?
answer: - This is to prevent any unauthorised use of your new physical card should it be intercepted or stolen while being delivered to you.

question: How can I activate my physical card?
answer: - After receiving your physical card, you can activate it in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Tap on 'Savings' 3. Select 'Track Your Physical Card' 4. Select 'Activate Card' and choose your activation method 5. Select 'Start' for NFC activation and hold your card to the back of your phone, or 6. Select 'Enter Activation Code Instead' for code activation and enter the code found in your welcome pack Do note that all new, replacement or renewal cards will require activation prior to usage.

question: Why is there no card information shown on my physical card?
answer: - This is an enhanced security measure to protect you from fraud. With no card number, CVV or expiry date on the card, this will make it more difficult for card fraud and theft. To view your card details, follow these steps in the Trust App > Click on 'Money' > Click on 'View and manage card' > Click on 'Card Details'.

question: Where can I find details (card number, expiry date, CVV) of my Trust card?
answer: - You can view your card details in a few easy steps: 1. Open your Trust App 2. Tap 'View Card' 2. Log in to your Trust App 3. Tap 'Card details'

question: How do I reset or change the PIN for my Trust card?
answer: - You can reset or change your credit card PIN in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Go to 'View Card' 3. Select 'Change your card PIN' and choose a new 6-digit PIN

question: Why is my physical card (both EMV chip and magnetic stripe) disabled for overseas usage?
answer: - It has been disabled by default to provide a higher level of security for cardholders. This is part of an industry-wide measure introduced by the Association of Banks in Singapore. As a result, the following functions may be affected: - Overseas ATM cash withdrawal - Overseas magnetic stripe transactions - Overseas contactless and chip card transactions To prevent the above from happening, you will need to activate your physical card for overseas usage. Do note that you will need to first activate your physical card if it's new, replaced or renewed. You can activate your physical card for overseas usage in a few easy steps: - Log in to your Trust App - Go to 'View Card' - Select 'Manage card settings' - Under ‘Physical card, contactless, ATM withdrawal’, turn on the setting for Overseas use

question: What should I do if my Trust card is lost or stolen?
answer: - You should report your lost or stolen card immediately by following these few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Go to 'View Card' 3. Select 'Replace Card' 4. Select 'My Card is Lost or Stolen' Alternatively, you can reach us via - Live chat or voice call on your Trust App - OR call us at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 )

question: I damaged my Trust card. How do I get a replacement card?
answer: - You can request for a replacement card in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Go to 'View Card' 3. Select 'Replace Card' 4. Select 'My Card is damaged'

question: I requested for a replacement card. What should I do if I do not receive my replacement Trust Link card/NTUC Link card?
answer: - Reach us via: - Live chat or voice call on your Trust App - OR call us at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 )

question: I'm a Union member, but the Trust card issued to me is the non-Union version. What should I do?
answer: - Reach us via: - Live chat or voice call on your Trust App - OR call us at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 )

question: I'm not a Union member, but the Trust card issued to me is the Union version. What should I do?
answer: - Reach us via: - Live chat or voice call on your Trust App - OR call us at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 )

question: Can I use my Trust card overseas for point of sale transactions or ATM withdrawals?
answer: - For overseas transactions, if you are prompted by the overseas merchant to key in a PIN, inform the merchant to perform a signature or contactless based transaction instead. If the merchant insists on you keying in a PIN, then you can set or reset your Trust card PIN from the Trust App . For ATM withdrawals, do not use ATMs that accept 4 digit PINs as our cards only work at ATMs which use 6 digit PINs. Only use ATMs with the VISA – Plus Logo If you hold both a Trust Link credit card account and a savings account, we recommend that you pair your card with savings account and select ‘Savings Account’ at the ATM during cash withdrawals so that they are withdrawn from your savings account even if there is no option to select to withdraw from your savings account at the ATM. Do note that cash withdrawals under credit account option are cash advances and will incur a cash advance fee (effective from 1 Feb 26) and interest charges.

question: Can I get concession fares for bus and MRT rides with my Trust Card?
answer: - Unfortunately, no. Concession fares for senior citizens, students, and other eligible groups are only available when using a dedicated concession card issued by TransitLink. This means that tapping your Trust Card for bus and MRT rides will always charge you the standard adult fare, regardless of your eligibility for a concession. The TransitLink system currently doesn't support concession fare processing for third-party cards like the Trust Card. Please check with TransitLink directly for alternatives.

question: What does TrustInvest Stocks offer?
answer: - We offer access to trade stocks and ETFs listed in US markets, as well as UK UCITS ETFs.

question: Are there any requirements to open a Stocks account?
answer: - You may apply for the Stocks account if: - You have an existing Savings account with Trust. - You are between 18 and 74 years old. Please note that US persons are ineligible to open a Stocks account with Trust. Download the Trust App to open a Savings account if you do not have one yet.

question: How do I start trading?
answer: - Before you can start trading, you first need to open a Stocks account by going to Trust App > Investments > Stocks. Follow the in-app instructions to open your Stocks account. Do note that your eligibility to open the Stocks account will be subject to the bank's internal assessment.

question: What fees will I be charged?
answer: - Trust offers zero commission for US stocks and ETFs trading until 31 December 2026 (0.05% with minimum USD 2.99 per trade thereafter). However, standard market fees still apply. UK UCITS ETFs trading is charged commission at 0.05% with minimum USD 4 per trade. 9% GST is applied on commissions and the Trade Confirmation will serve as Tax Invoice. Trust does not charge any platform, custody, settlement and corporate action handling fees. For details, please refer to the Stocks Fee Schedule by going to Trust App > Profile > Legal.

question: Is my investment capital guaranteed?
answer: - All investments involve risks and are not guaranteed. You could lose all or part of your original investment amount.

question: Why am I missing the Investments section in the Trust App?
answer: - Only eligible customers can see the Investments section in Trust App. Please ensure that you are using the latest version of Trust App. Need help? Please contact us via the in-app chat or call us at +65 313-TRUST (+65 3138 7878).

question: What is the minimum amount to invest?
answer: - You can buy stocks and ETFs with as little as USD 10.

question: What is the difference between Stocks account and Savings account?
answer: - The Stocks account is solely used for investing in stocks and ETFs, and cannot be used for other banking purposes. Unlike the Savings account, the Stocks account is non-interest bearing and not insured under the Deposit Insurance Scheme managed by the Singapore Deposit Insurance Corporation (SDIC).

question: Where are my investment monies held?
answer: - Your monies and assets are held with our custodian in accordance with the Securities and Futures Act.

question: Will cash in my Stocks account earn interest?
answer: - No, the cash in your Stocks account will not earn interest.

question: Does Trust provide investment advice?
answer: - No, Trust does not provide any investment advice to customers.

question: Can I use CPF or SRS account to fund my investments?
answer: - No, Trust only supports stocks and ETFs trading via cash. Monies from CPF or SRS accounts cannot be used for stocks and ETFs trading at this time.

question: I'm facing technical issues on the Trust App. What should I do?
answer: - For assistance, please contact us via the in-app chat or call us at +65 313-TRUST (+65 3138 7878).

question: What are the risks involved with investment?
answer: - Investment involves risks, and you could lose all or part of your original investment amount. The price of stocks and ETFs will move up and down. As a result, the value of your investment may increase or decrease. Past performance is not a guide to future performance. For details, please refer to the "Risk Warning for Stocks and Exchange Traded Funds" and "TrustInvest - product terms" under Legal ( https://trustbank.sg/legal/ ).

question: Are my investments insured under SDIC?
answer: - Investments and monies inside the Stocks account are not insured under the Deposit Insurance Scheme managed by the Singapore Deposit Insurance Corporation (SDIC).

question: What are UK UCITS ETFs?
answer: - UCITS ETFs traded on the London Stock Exchange are European-regulated exchange traded funds designed for improved risk management and diversification. Unlike US ETFs which are subject to a 30% withholding tax on dividends, Irish-domiciled UCITS ETFs are only subject to a 15% withholding tax on dividends for Singaporean investors residing in Singapore. This is for information only and does not constitute tax, legal, or financial advice. Base currency for trading UK UCITS ETFs offered by Trust is US Dollars (USD).

question: Which UCITS ETFs can I trade?
answer: - Trust currently offers 40 UCITS ETFs on the London Stock Exchange (LSE) available for fractional trading in USD. We do not offer stocks on the LSE.

question: Where do I find the list of UK UCITS ETFs offered by Trust?
answer: - You can find them under Investments > Stocks > Trade > UCITS under Browse by category.

question: How do I differentiate between US and UK ETFs on Trust app?
answer: - When searching for a specific stock or ETF ticker, US stocks and ETFs will be identified with a 'US' label, while UK UCITS ETFs will be identified with a 'UK' label.

question: What is Trust+?
answer: - Trust+ is a new level of banking experience from Trust designed to help customers better grow their savings in a simple and transparent way. Customers who maintain min. S$100K eligible balances across their Trust savings account Average Daily Balance (ADB) and/or TrustInvest account value will automatically qualify for Trust+ from the following month. Customers who qualify for Trust+ will also get to enjoy exclusive 1-for-1 privileges, a metal card, a differentiated app experience, and priority in-app customer service.

question: How do I qualify for Trust+?
answer: - Customers who maintain min. S$100K total across their Trust savings account Average Daily Balance (ADB) and/or TrustInvest Mutual Funds or Stocks account value will automatically qualify for Trust+ from the following month. You will be a Trust+ customer for the next three consecutive months and will continue to be a Trust+ customer if you continue to meet our eligibility criteria. E.g., if you maintain S$100K total balances or higher for Jan, you will qualify for Trust+ for Feb, Mar and Apr. If you maintain min. S$100K total balances in Feb, you will continue to be a Trust+ customer for Mar, Apr and May.

question: What are the privileges for Trust+?
answer: - As a Trust+ customer, you will be able to enjoy up to 2.4% interest p.a. on your first S$1.2M deposit (with Flex plan and the fulfilment of relevant bonus interest criteria), exclusive 1-for-1 privileges at curated merchants, a metal card, a differentiated app experience, and priority in-app customer service.

question: Will I be charged any fees for Trust+?
answer: - There are currently no fees such as joining fee and fall below fee for Trust+. However, as a Trust customer, other fees and charges as interest charges on unpaid credit card balances remain applicable.

question: Will I be able to cancel Trust+?
answer: - Your Trust+ status is valid for 3 months upon qualification. Your Trust+ status will automatically expire if you are unable to maintain the min. S$100K eligible balances for each of the 3 months.

question: How do I get a metal card?
answer: - If you are a Trust+ member, you can request for your metal card in 4 easy steps: - Log in to Trust App - Tap on the profile icon on the top right - Tap on your name - Tap on ‘metal card’ If you upgrade to the metal card: - Your old card will be blocked immediately - You’ll get a new physical and digital card with a new number - Your new physical card will be delivered to you as soon as possible but your digital card can be used right away - Remember to update your new card number in Apple/Google Pay and wherever else your card is added (e.g. FairPrice Group app)

question: When will my metal card arrive?
answer: - We are working to deliver the new card to you as soon as possible. Typically, your new card will arrive within 6-7 working days from your replacement date. In the meantime, you can start using your digital card right away! Remember to update your new card number in your mobile apps and online checkouts.

question: Can I continue using my metal card after my Trust+ membership expires?
answer: - Yes, you can continue using your metal card even after your Trust+ membership expires.

question: Is there a charge for replacing the metal card?
answer: - Metal card is complimentary for the 1st issuance but chargeable for subsequent replacements. Do keep your card in a safe place!

question: Is replacing to the metal card compulsory? I would like to stick with my current plastic physical card.
answer: - Absolutely, the choice is yours! However, please note that your digital card in Trust App will show metal card as long as you continue to be a Trust+ customer, while you continue to use your current plastic physical card.

question: How do I qualify for the metal card?
answer: - The metal card is exclusively for Trust+ customers! Qualify for Trust+ and you will have the option to upgrade to the metal card. Do note that we will be rolling out the metal card to our customers in batches.

question: What is the difference between my Trust Link / NTUC Link card and the metal card?
answer: - The metal card is exclusively for you, the Trust+ customer 😉 Benefits and features from your Trust Link / NTUC Link card will not change! Spends on your metal card will earn Linkpoints at the same rate.

question: What Life Insurance plans will Trust be offering?
answer: - We will be offering savings, term, whole life and investment-linked plans in partnership with Income Insurance Limited (Income Insurance). Income Insurance is one of the leading composite insurers in Singapore, offering life, health and general insurance.

question: Where can I find out more information about Life Insurance in Trust App?
answer: - Do ensure that your Trust App is updated to the latest version. Then on the home page, look for "Insure" on the bottom navigation bar to access our Insurance offerings. For more information about life insurance products, you can refer to "Products" within the Insure tab.

question: How can I buy Life Insurance plans?
answer: - You can reach out to our Insurance Specialists through Trust App. They are licensed to advise on Life and Health Insurance plans as well as Investment-Linked plans.

question: Who is eligible for Life Insurance?
answer: - Different insurance plans may have different minimum and maximum entry ages for the policyholder and life insured. Application for life insurance will also be subjected to Trust's review and Income's terms and conditions. At Trust, we generally offer Life Insurance to customers aged 18 to 74 years old.

question: Who can help me with the questions that I have for Life Insurance?
answer: - Our Insurance Specialists are most happy to answer questions on Life Insurance. You can connect with them via Trust App > Insure > Connect with Insurance Specialist.

question: What is Balance Transfer?
answer: - Balance Transfer is a short-term loan in Singapore that allows you to convert a portion of your Trust credit card available limit into funds at 0% interest. These funds can be used to clear your other outstanding credit card balances with other banks or for your short term cash needs.

question: Am I eligible for Balance Transfer?
answer: - You must have sufficient available credit limit to be eligible for Balance Transfer.

question: How do I apply for Balance Transfer?
answer: - You can apply for Balance Transfer via our app. Simply tap on Trust App > More > Loan > Other Flexible Loans to get started.

question: What are the fees for taking up Balance Transfer?
answer: - We only charge a one-time fee when you apply for Balance Transfer. There are no other hidden fees!

question: How long will it take for my Balance Transfer to be approved?
answer: - Most Balance Transfer will be approved and deposited to your Trust savings account within 60 seconds.

question: How do I repay my balance transfer?
answer: - We will charge a monthly Balance Transfer loan repayment amount, and this will be reflected in your monthly credit card statement. Simply tap on Trust App > Money > Credit Card > Pay credit card.

question: What happens if I don’t make full payment on my monthly charge amount?
answer: - If you don't pay the full amount due on or before the payment due date, the unpaid principal of the monthly charge amount will be charged a daily interest of 0.077% (27.9% p.a.)* until the date the payment is received. *From 1 July 2026, your credit card Effective Interest Rate (EIR) will be personalised based on your credit behaviour. Your rate will range from 18.9% p.a. to 29.9% p.a.

question: How is my Balance Transfer monthly charge calculated?
answer: - Before end of tenure: 3% (for Balance Transfers approved before 13 August 2026), or 1% (for Balance Transfers approved on or after 13 August 2026) of the outstanding amount will be charged to your credit card statement on a monthly basis and included in the minimum amount due. In last month of tenure, or if you choose to repay before the last month: The remaining outstanding balance will be charged to your credit card statement and 1% of the outstanding amount will be included in the minimum amount due. For more information, please refer to Balance Transfer Product Terms & Key Facts.

question: What is Effective Interest Rate (EIR)?
answer: - EIR reflects the true cost of borrowing. We calculate the Effective Interest Rate (EIR) by considering the processing fee and assuming that each minimum monthly payment is paid on time and that the remaining loan amount is paid in the last month.

question: Can I repay my Balance Transfer early?
answer: - You may make a partial or full repayment anytime with no penalty fee.

question: Are there any Trust exclusive offers for Insurance?
answer: - Yes, there may be Trust exclusive offers for Trust customers from time to time for eligible Income Insurance Limited policies. For the latest offers available, please check your Trust App or website.

question: How can I enjoy the Trust exclusive offer that is available?
answer: - You must be a Trust customer and have to buy the insurance policy through the Trust App or website to enjoy the Trust exclusive offer. The offer will automatically be applied when you checkout and pay. Promotion Terms and Conditions apply. Trust's General Terms and Conditions apply. You may find them on the Trust App or website.

question: Can I enjoy the Trust exclusive offer with Income promotions?
answer: - Yes, you can. The Trust exclusive offer is applied after any ongoing Income promotions. For the latest Income promotions, please visit https://www.income.com.sg

question: I did not buy through Trust App or website and thus did not enjoy the Trust exclusive offer. Can Trust accord the exclusive offer to me?
answer: - Trust will not be able to accord the exclusive offer. Purchase must be made through the Trust App or website.

question: Must I pay with a Trust Credit or Debit Card?
answer: - Yes. You must buy using a Trust Card or Trust Savings Account to enjoy the Trust exclusive offer.

question: I bought an insurance policy from Income’s website. Can I cancel the policy and buy again through the Trust App or website to enjoy the Trust exclusive offer?
answer: - No. Customers who cancel and buy again will not be eligible for the Trust exclusive offer.

question: Who should I reach out to if I have any further queries regarding Income insurance products?
answer: - You may contact Income at https://www.income.com.sg/contact-us for further enquiries regarding Income insurance products.

question: I am not a Link member. Will a new Link account be created for me?
answer: - Yes, upon the approval of your application, we will create a new Link membership ID and link it to your new Trust card. Once it's linked, you can start earning Linkpoints with your Trust card and view your Linkpoints balance and transactions in your Trust App.

question: My Trust Link card/NTUC Link card is tied to an incorrect Link account. What should I do? Can I merge my Link accounts?

question: My current Link account is linked to my OCBC Plus!/NTUC Plus! Card. Will I have any issues if I apply for Trust Link/NTUC Link card?
answer: - When you successfully apply for your Trust card, your Link account will be automatically tagged to your new Trust Link/NTUC Link account. In your Trust App, you will be able to see your Linkpoints balance and transactions made using your Trust card. For more information regarding NTUC / OCBC Plus! Visa Card or Linkpoints, please visit the Link Rewards website . Alternatively, you may reach out to FPG Customer Care Team via a webform at https://support.link.sg/hc/en-us/requests/new .

question: Can my Trust Link card/NTUC Link card be used to identify me as a Link member and/or NTUC Union member?
answer: - Yes. You can present your Trust Link card to identify yourself as a Link member, and you can present your NTUC Link card to identify yourself as both a Link member and a NTUC Union member.

question: What transactions are ineligible transactions and will therefore not earn you any Linkpoints?
answer: - The following are ineligible transactions: - Any cash advance. - Transactions on your credit card that are subsequently cancelled, voided, refunded or reversed or incurred by you but aren’t submitted or posted to your credit card. - AXS, SAM or ATM transactions made using your credit card. - Any insurance premiums. - Any fees (for example annual card fees, service fees, interest, administrative fees, finance fees, and/or late payment fees). - Amounts which have been rolled over from any preceding month’s statement. - Any top-ups or payment of funds to any accounts. - Any transaction classified under any of the following Merchant Category Codes: - Utilities, Rentals and Cleaning Services – 4900, 6513, 7349. - Financial Institutions, Securities – Brokers, Quasi Cash, Insurance, Stored Value Card Purchase/Load and Wire Transfer – 4829, 5960, 6010, 6011, 6012, 6051, 6211, 6300, 6540. - Gambling – 7995. - Educational Institutions – 8211, 8220, 8241, 8244, 8249, 8299. - Charitable services, political organisations, religious organisations and government payments – 8398, 8651, 8661, 9211, 9222, 9223, 9311, 9399, 9402, 9405. - Other services – 7399* - Any other fees or payments as we may decide. Do note that Trust is entitled to clawback or withdraw any excess Linkpoints issued at its sole discretion. For more information on our rewards, please refer to https://trustbank.sg/faqs/credit-card/#what-are-the-reward-of-the-trust-link-credit-card-and-debit-card-how-do-i-earn * From 15 May 2026, transactions under the following MCC will be classified as ineligible: 7399

question: When will I receive my earned Linkpoints (excluding monthly and quarterly bonus Linkpoints)?
answer: - We aim to credit the Linkpoints for your Eligible Spend to you in real-time (i.e., as soon as they are earned and posted!). However, there may be times when it can take us up to a day. Eligible Spend consists of Local Eligible Spend and Foreign Eligible Spend. Local Eligible Spend refers to all Visa transactions on your credit card or debit card in Singapore Dollars, and where the transaction is processed in Singapore, excluding FPG spend and ineligible transactions. You will receive 0.22% Linkpoints on all Local Eligible Spend, with no cap. For supplementary cardholders, Linkpoints will be awarded to the main cardholder. Foreign Eligible Spend refers to all Visa transactions made on your credit card or debit card that are not in Singapore Dollars, or where the transaction is processed outside of Singapore (including transactions that are converted into Singapore dollars via Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC)), excluding FPG spend and ineligible transactions. You will receive 0.22% Linkpoints on all Foreign Eligible Spend, with no cap. For supplementary cardholders, Linkpoints will be awarded to the main cardholder. For the list of ineligible transactions, refer to https://trustbank.sg/faqs/linkpoints/#what-transactions-are-ineligible-transactions-and-will-therefore-not-earn-you-any-linkpoints?search=true

question: When will I receive my monthly bonus Linkpoints on FairPrice Group spend?
answer: - Once you've met your minimum monthly spend ($450 for NTUC Link Credit cardholders, $550 for Trust Link Credit cardholders, or $300 for NTUC Link Debit and Trust Link Debit cardholders) which is based on the posting date (not transaction date) of your transactions, you'll receive the monthly bonus Linkpoints on all your posted FPG spend*. Subsequently, you'll receive the monthly bonus Linkpoints on FPG spend* once they are posted in the same month. *FPG groceries includes FairPrice, FairPrice Finest, FairPrice Xtra, FairPrice Xpress, FairPrice Online, Warehouse Club, Unity and Cheers stores (excluding FairPrice Xpress and Cheers outlets located within Esso stations) and FPG food includes participating Kopitiam stalls. FPG groceries and food spend will, together, also be referred to as FPG spend.

question: When will I receive my quarterly bonus Linkpoints on  FairPrice Group spend?
answer: - Once you've met your minimum monthly spend ($450 for NTUC Link Credit cardholders, $550 for Trust Link Credit cardholders, or $300 for NTUC Link Debit and Trust Link Debit cardholders) which is based on the posting date (not transaction date) of your transactions for 3 consecutive months starting from the first month that your card is approved, you'll receive the quarterly bonus Linkpoints on all your posted FPG spend* in the quarter. Subsequently, you'll receive the quarterly bonus Linkpoints on FPG spend* once they are posted in the month. Earn additional quarterly bonus when you meet the following minimum monthly spend ($800 for NTUC Link Credit and Trust Link Credit cardholders, or $500 for NTUC Link Debit and Trust Link Debit cardholders) which is based on the posting date (not transaction date) of your transactions for 3 consecutive months starting from the first month that your card is approved, you'll receive the quarterly bonus Linkpoints on all your posted FPG spend* in the quarter. question: How do I view my earned Linkpoints?
answer: - You can view your earned Linkpoints in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Go to 'Dashboard' 3. Select 'Rewards' 4. Select 'Link Rewards'

question: What happens to my Linkpoints if I return or refund the product(s) purchased with my Credit Card?
answer: - Unfortunately, the Linkpoints you had previously earned on the purchase would have to be reversed out of your account.

question: How do I connect a Link membership to my FairPrice app?
answer: - Please visit https://help.fairprice.com.sg/hc/en-us/articles/360049935451-How-do-I-connect-a-Link-membership-to-my-FairPrice-account-

question: How can I earn Linkpoints when I'm at FairPrice physical stores?
answer: - You will first need to: - Tap your physical Trust card (if you have received it); or - Scan your QR code from the FairPrice app (under 'Payment') Thereafter, you may make your payment using your Trust card added to Apple Pay / Google Pay, physical Trust card or via the FairPrice app (where Trust card is added as the default payment mode).

question: Do I earn Linkpoints when I pay using Apple Pay/Google Pay at FairPrice?
answer: - Yes, you will earn the monthly and quarterly bonuses if you meet the minimum spend requirement. However, to earn the Linkpoints base rate given by FairPrice Group as well as FairPrice member benefits (if applicable), do remember to tap your physical Trust card or scan your QR code from your FairPrice App (under 'Payment') before making payment.

question: How does the revision of Linkpoints rewards from 1 April 2024 affect me?
answer: - The new Monthly and Quarterly Linkpoints bonus rates will apply from 1 April 2024 for all customers regardless of when your quarter starts. For example, if your quarter starts in Jan 2024 / Feb 2024/ Mar 2024, the revised Monthly and Quarterly bonus rates will apply from 1 Apr 2024 onwards. In addition, the new Quarterly Linkpoints Cap will apply from 1 Apr 2024 for new Trust customers (i.e., customers who have signed up for a Trust credit card and/or debit card from 1 Apr 2024 onwards). For existing customers, if your quarter starts in Feb 2024, your Quarterly Linkpoints Cap will be based on the revised cap for your quarter from Feb to Apr 2024. If your quarter starts in Mar 2024, your Quarterly Linkpoints Cap will be based on the revised cap for your quarter from Mar to May 2024.

question: Am I eligible to apply for a credit card?
answer: - You can apply for a credit card if: - You are between 21 years old and 55 years old; and - Have an annual income of S$30,000 if Singaporean citizen or permanent resident; or - Have an annual income of S$60,000 if foreigner with a valid work pass OR if: - You are above 55 years old; and - Have an annual income of S$15,000 if Singaporean citizen or permanent resident; or - Have an annual income of S$60,000 if foreigner with a valid work pass

question: What do I need to prepare when applying for a credit card?
answer: - For a Singaporean citizen or permanent resident, we recommend you to use MyInfo as it pre-fills your application form quickly and effortlessly. If you are a foreigner, in addition to Myinfo, you will need to upload or take a photo of your passport and latest payslip.

question: I already have a Standard Chartered credit card. Can I skip the application process to automatically get a Trust credit card?
answer: - No, you still need to sign up for a Trust credit card. The application process is fully automated so it should be quick and easy. Do note that if you're a Singaporean citizen or permanent resident and your annual income is between SGD 30,000 and SGD 120,000, your credit limit with Trust will be combined with your Standard Chartered credit limit.

question: How long does the application take?
answer: - Most applications take less than 3 minutes. However, if we need clarifications from you, it may take up to 3 working days.

question: Why was my application for the credit card unsuccessful?
answer: - All applications go through an internal assessment process, and we consider all applications carefully. Due to the bank's policy and confidentiality guidelines, we cannot reveal the reasons for your unsuccessful application.

question: I'm a retiree, can I still apply for Trust credit card?
answer: - Yes, you may qualify for a credit card with a S$500 credit limit (subject to meeting other standard bank requirements), if you meet the below criteria: - Singapore citizens and permanent residents - Age 56 years and above - Assessed annual income less than S$15,000 - No credit card or unsecured loan with Standard Chartered Bank

question: I’m a retiree, how do I provide my CPF LIFE payouts as proof of income during my credit card or credit limit increase application?
answer: - During your application, you will need to select your employment type as ‘Retiree’. If your age is 65 and above, you will be prompted to upload a copy of your CPF LIFE payout transaction history within the last 2 months, as proof of income. You may find your CPF LIFE payout transaction history under my CPF portal > My dashboards > Retirement > Monthly payouts > Monthly payout history. Please ensure that you are on the latest version of Trust app.

question: Why did I get a S$500 credit limit on my credit card?
answer: - Customers who receive a S$500 credit limit meet the following criteria: - Singapore citizens and permanent residents - Age 56 years and above - Assessed annual income less than S$15,000 - No credit card or unsecured loan with Standard Chartered Bank

question: I don’t receive CPF LIFE payouts (or I’ve deferred them), but I’m seeing a CPF LIFE payout screen during my credit card application. What should I do?
answer: - No worries! If you’re not receiving CPF LIFE payouts or have chosen to defer them, simply tap “I don’t have CPF LIFE Payout” on the screen to continue with your application. We’ll assess your application using information from Singpass and your overall credit exposure, in line with regulatory guidelines.

question: Where can I find out more about how credit cards work and the latest credit card and unsecured credit rules?
answer: - You can find detailed information on credit cards and credit usage in the Consumer Guide for Credit Cards published on the website of The Association of Banks in Singapore (ABS): https://abs.org.sg/consumer-banking/consumer-guides

question: How can I get a free credit report?
answer: - You may obtain it within 30 calendar days from the date of approval or rejection of your credit card application or credit limit increase application via the credit bureau website listed below. Alternatively, you may present the approval or rejection email and your NRIC/passport to the following credit bureau’s registered office to obtain a free credit report. For existing credit card customers applying for a new credit card, you can get a free credit report by presenting the approval or rejection email and your NRIC/passport to credit bureau’s registered office. Credit Bureau (Singapore) Pte Ltd 2 Shenton Way, #20-02 SGX Centre 1, Singapore 068804 www.creditbureau.com.sg

question: How can I increase my credit limit?
answer: - You can increase your credit limit in a few steps via Trust App: - Go to View Card or Profile > Settings - Select ‘Increase credit limit’ - Complete and submit your credit limit increase request Your request will be subject to the bank’s approval, based on our internal assessment.

question: Who is eligible for credit limit increase?
answer: - Currently, all active principal cardholders can apply for credit limit increase. Exclusion: Credit limit increase is not applicable for customers with existing credit cards of $500 limit, or customers who already have a limit of $150K (maximum limit offered by Trust).

question: How will I be notified about my credit limit increase request outcome?
answer: - Under most circumstances, your credit limit increase request outcome should be instant. We will also notify you via in-app push and email notifications.

question: If my Credit Limit Increase request shows ‘Pending’ status, how long do I need to wait for an outcome and how will I be notified?
answer: - If the request shows ‘Pending’ status, it means that we are reviewing your application and will get back to you within 3 business days. You will receive an update on the outcome via in-app push and email notifications.

question: Can I cancel my credit limit increase request after it has been submitted?
answer: - Once submitted, your credit limit increase request cannot be cancelled. Cardholders will be notified of the outcome via in-app push and email notifications. You may however choose the ‘Decrease credit limit’ option from Trust App, should you wish to bring your credit limit down.

question: Why was my credit limit increase request unsuccessful?
answer: - At Trust Bank, all credit limit increase requests are assessed carefully in line with our credit risk management policies, as well as regulatory requirements. Your request may be declined due to one or more of the following reasons::​ - Not meeting the eligibility criteria, - Insufficient income​ based on your latest Singpass data - Overall credit exposure Please note that all credit limit reviews and revisions are subject to the Bank’s approval, based on data retrieved from Singpass and overall credit exposure to comply with regulatory requirements.

question: Why is my credit card limit decreased, or my credit facility is being terminated?
answer: - Trust Bank reviews available information from time to time to ensure your credit card limit remains suitable based on your financial profile. As part of this review, we may make adjustments — including reducing or, in some cases, terminating the credit facility taking into account your latest income data and overall credit exposure. These decisions are carefully assessed, in line with regulatory requirements and the bank’s credit risk management policies. If you need further information on regulatory requirements around granting new credit card limit and/or credit card limit increase, you may refer to the below links: https://abs.org.sg/consumer-banking/consumers/revised-credit- card-and-unsecured-credit-rules ​ https://www.mas.gov.sg/regulation/explainers/Issuing-Credit-Cards

question: Why is there a change in my cash advance limit?
answer: - Trust may change your cash advance limit for various reasons, such as changes in your credit score or credit utilisation, or changes in our internal policies or regulatory requirements.

question: Can Trust Bank revise my cash advance limit at any point in time?
answer: - Yes, Trust Bank reserves the right to lower your cash advance limit.

question: Who are regulated customers?
answer: - Regulated customers are Singapore citizens or Singapore permanent residents, whose annual income is below SGD 120,000.

question: What is the significance or impact of being a regulated customer?
answer: - It will affect the maximum overall credit limit for Singapore citizens and Singapore permanent residents that can be assigned for unsecured credit facilities across Trust and Standard Chartered : - For regulated customers whose annual income is between SGD 30,000 to less than SGD 120,000: Up to 4 months' income - For regulated customers who are aged above 55 years old whose annual income is less than SGD 30,000: Up to 2 months' income

question: If I am a regulated customer, what has my Standard Chartered credit limit got to do with my application for the credit card?
answer: - If you already have an existing unsecured credit facility with Standard Chartered and wish to apply for a credit card, Trust will need to apply the overall credit limit to your unsecured credit facilities across Standard Chartered and Trust. For example, if your monthly income is SGD 5,000, then your overall credit limit is SGD 20,000 (4 times your monthly income). If your Standard Chartered credit limit is SGD 12,000, Trust will be able to grant you a credit limit of up to SGD 8,000, unless you decide to transfer your credit limit from Standard to Trust (link to next question). Here are some illustrations to help you understand this better: If you would like Trust to decide your credit limit, click here . If you would like to decide your own credit limit and would like a Trust credit limit that is higher than what has been assigned to you, click here . If you would like to decide your own credit limit and are happy with the Trust credit limit assigned to you, click here .

question: Why am I provided with the option of transferring my credit limit from Standard Chartered products to Trust?
answer: - This option can be an alternative in the event that Trust is unable to approve your preferred credit limit based on our credit assessment of your application. You can get a credit card by transferring some of your unutilised credit limit from your existing Standard Chartered products to credit card. Another thing to note: This is only applicable for regulated customers and it is a one-time transfer available at the point of your credit card application and no reversal can be made once you choose to proceed with this credit limit transfer option.

question: Can I reinstate my original credit card limit with Standard Chartered after I choose to proceed with transferring my credit limit to Trust?
answer: - The option to transfer available credit limit from Standard Chartered to Trust is an exclusive option provided to you only during your credit card application with Trust. As this is a one-time process, no reversal can be made once you proceed with this option.

question: When will the limit change be effective?
answer: - Trust will grant you the limit immediately. Standard Chartered will also notify you of the limit change (if you opted for a transfer of limit).

question: I have multiple credit cards with Standard Chartered with different limits. How will you apportion the revised limit among all my cards?
answer: - The credit card limit assigned by Standard Chartered is common across all credit cards held by you. For example, if your credit card limit is SGD 20,000 and you have 3 credit cards, the total spend across the 3 cards will be capped at SGD 20,000. Therefore, any limit you transfer to Trust will reduce the overall credit card limit you have with Standard Chartered.

question: If I cancel my credit card in the future, will Trust automatically transfer my credit limit back to my Standard Chartered products?
answer: - No, it would not be possible to automatically transfer your Trust credit limit back to your Standard Chartered credit products. You can however request for an increase in your credit limit via Standard Chartered customer care. Don't hesitate to call our Customer Care Team for assistance. Reach us via: - Live chat or voice call on your Trust App - OR call us at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 ) You may also contact Standard Chartered service hotline to further assist you. Visit www.sc.com/sg/help/contact-us/ for more information.

question: What happens if I am not a regulated customer now but become a regulated customer later on?
answer: - Your credit limit will be reviewed and will be adjusted if your overall credit limit with Trust and Standard Chartered has exceeded the prevailing regulatory limit. If your existing outstanding balance exceeds the regulatory limit, you are required to pay off the excess balance above your revised credit limit with Trust. Otherwise, charges will apply accordingly.

question: Can I decrease my credit limit?
answer: - You can decrease your credit limit in a few steps on Trust App: - Go to ‘Profile’ > ‘Settings’ - Select ‘Decrease your credit limit’ - Tap and drag the slider to set your desired credit limit and confirm

question: Can I request for a temporary credit limit increase?
answer: - At the moment, we do not offer temporary credit limit increase.

question: What are the features of the Trust Cashback card?

question: How do I choose my preferred category?
answer: - You will be given the option to select your preferred category once your card application is approved. question: What are the different preferred categories to choose from to earn up to 15% cashback on my Trust Cashback card?
answer: - There are 6 categories which you can choose from – shopping, dining, transport, travel, wellness and entertainment. You can change your preferred category every quarter. It’s your choice!

question: Can I change my preferred category?
answer: - Of course! You can change your next quarter's chosen preferred category any time before the next quarter starts. Do so by going to Rewards > Cashback > Next Quarter in the Trust App. Once the quarter starts, you will not be able to change your preferred category for the current quarter.

question: How do I earn up to 15% cashback on my preferred category?

question: When will I receive my quarterly cashback for my transactions?
answer: - If you are eligible, your quarterly cashback will normally be credited by 6pm on the 1st day and 11th day of your new quarter, subject to the quarterly cashback cap: - All transactions made on your preferred category that are charged and completed within the same quarter, the quarterly cashback will be credited on 1st day of the new quarter. - For the remaining transactions made on your preferred category that are charged at the end of the quarter and only posted after the new quarter began, the quarterly cashback will be credited on 11th day of the new quarter. question: How is my quarter counted for my Cashback card?
answer: - Your quarter will start based on the month your card is approved. For example, if your card is approved on 28 Sep 2024, your quarter will be from Sep to Nov 2024. However, if your card is approved on 3 Oct 2024, your quarter will be from Oct to Dec 2024.

question: How much quarterly cashback will I get if I miss the minimum spend for one month?

question: When will the estimated quarterly cashback be calculated? How is the estimated quarterly cashback calculated?
answer: - Your estimated quarterly cashback on your preferred category is tracked real-time in your Trust App under Rewards > Cashback. The estimated quarterly cashback is calculated based on completed transactions. For example, if you have made a transaction on your preferred category today (20 Aug) and this transaction is not yet completed, the estimated quarterly cashback will not include the cashback for this transaction. The cashback for this transaction will only be included in the estimated quarterly cashback when the transaction is completed. Merchants have up to 10 calendar days to complete the transaction. The quarterly cashback rate used to calculate the estimated quarterly cashback amount is based on the minimum spend you have met. For example, if you have met the minimum spend of S$500, then the estimated quarterly cashback shown is calculated based on 5%. You can see the estimated cashback under Rewards > Cashback.

question: I have made a purchase at a particular merchant which should be under my chosen preferred category. Why am I not getting my quarterly cashback for my purchase?
answer: - We use MCCs to determine which category the transactions fall under. The MCC is assigned by the merchant’s acquiring bank based on the MCC which best describes the merchant activity. For example, restaurant like SKAI restaurant which is located within Swissotel The Stamford may be under Hotel MCC 3590 instead of MCC 5812 - Eating Places and Restaurants. Hence, if you have selected Dining as your preferred category, you will not earn the quarterly cashback on the transaction made there.

question: Why did I not receive my Scratch card after hitting the milestones?
answer: - Scratch cards earned will be available in your Trust app under Rewards> Quests section 24H of completion of the milestones. If you have not received the Scratch card after 24H, please reach out to us via live chat or voice call on your Trust App for us to investigate this accordingly.

question: What is the minimum spend I must hit for the first month in which my cashback card is approved to qualify for the quarterly cashback?
answer: - There is no minimum spend requirement for the first month in which your cashback card is approved.

question: How does the minimum spend requirement to earn cashback work?
answer: - You will start earning quarterly cashback on your Trust Cashback card spend when you meet the monthly minimum Eligible Spend. For the month in which your card is approved, there is no minimum spend requirement. For example, regardless if your card is approved on 3 or 28 Sep 2024, there is no minimum spend require for the month of Sep 2024 and you will be eligible to earn up to 15% cashback for the quarter, capped at S$250 per quarter, if you meet the monthly minimum eligible spend of $2,000 in the next 2 months. Simply log in to your Trust App under Rewards > Cashback to track your spends.

question: What transactions will be counted towards my minimum spend for my Cashback card?
answer: - Eligible spend will be counted towards your minimum spend, based on your transaction date (i.e. once the transaction is authorized/charged to your cashback card). Eligible Spend refers to all Visa transactions made on your cashback card, excluding ineligible transactions (Please see “What are the ineligible transactions which are not eligible to earn cashback”). For example, if the transaction is charged on 30 Sep but completed and posted on 2 Oct 2024, the transaction is counted towards your Sep 2024 Spend.

question: How do I know if I have met the minimum spend for my Trust Cashback card?
answer: - You can easily track your spend in your Trust App under Rewards > Cashback. As soon as you have made an Eligible spend and the transaction is authorised/charged to your cashback card, you will see your spend track in the spend tracker.

question: Does refund affect my minimum spend for the month for my Cashback card?
answer: - Yes, any transaction refund will reduce your minimum spend accumulated for the month. If cashback has been awarded for the transaction, the cashback will be reversed accordingly.

question: Will I earn 0.5%/1% cashback on my preferred category?
answer: - Yes. This is in addition to earning up to 15%^ bonus cashback on your preferred category. All Local Eligible Spend (both in your non-preferred and preferred category) will earn 1% unlimited instant cashback, and all Foreign Eligible Spend (both in your non-preferred and preferred category) will earn 0.5% unlimited instant cashback. Eligible Spend means Local Eligible Spend and Foreign Eligible Spend . - Local Eligible Spend refers to all Visa transactions on your Cashback card in Singapore Dollars, and where the transaction is processed in Singapore, excluding ineligible transactions. - Foreign Eligible Spend refers to all Visa transactions made on your Cashback card that are not in Singapore Dollars, or where the transaction is processed outside of Singapore (including transactions that are converted into Singapore dollars via Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC)), excluding ineligible transactions. - See our Cashback card Product Terms for the list of ineligible transactions. ^ 15% cashback on your preferred category is capped at S$250 per quarter. Actual overall cashback earned varies depending on spend criteria you meet.

question: When will I receive 0.5%/1% cashback credited to my Trust Cashback card?
answer: - You will receive the cashback as soon as the transaction is posted and completed. - All Local Eligible Spend will earn 1% unlimited instant cashback - All Foreign Eligible Spend will earn 0.5% unlimited instant cashback Eligible Spend means Local Eligible Spend and Foreign Eligible Spend . - Local Eligible Spend refers to all Visa transactions on your Cashback card in Singapore Dollars, and where the transaction is processed in Singapore, excluding ineligible transactions. - Foreign Eligible Spend refers to all Visa transactions made on your Cashback card that are not in Singapore Dollars, or where the transaction is processed outside of Singapore (including transactions that are converted into Singapore dollars via Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC)), excluding ineligible transactions. - See our Cashback card Product Terms for the list of ineligible transactions. For your quarterly cashback of up to 15% on your preferred category, see FAQ under credit card: "When will I receive my quarterly cashback for my transactions?"

question: Why am I earning 1% cashback on my other spends and not 1.5%?
answer: - 1.5% cashback on other Eligible Spend is a promotional offer for new to Trust cashback customers only until 31 Dec 2024 and will change to 1% from 1 Jan 2025. All other cashback customers get 1% cashback on all other eligible spend.

question: I have been getting 1.5% cashback on all other spends. How much cashback (1.5% or 1%) will I get for my transaction charge on 31 Dec 2024?
answer: - For new Trust customers only, you will earn 1.5% cashback for transactions posted by 31 Dec 2024. But if the transaction is posted after 31 Dec 2024, you will earn 1% cashback on the transaction.

question: Is there a minimum spend to earn cashback?
answer: - Yes, you will only earn cashback on transaction of at least S$1. Cashback earned for each transaction is rounded to the nearest 2 decimal place.

question: Why is my transaction reflected as “Manual Debit” on my statement and there is no cashback awarded for my transaction?
answer: - Your transaction was not processed and cleared automatically during settlement and had to be processed manually and debited to your card instead. We are unable to track transactions that were posted manually like the standard transactions thus we are unable to award any cashback or count it towards your minimum spend.

question: Why does my total spend under Spend Insights different from Cashback tracker?
answer: - All your card spends will be reflected under your Spend Insights however only eligible card spends will be reflected under your Cashback tracker.

question: I have spent $550 on Shopping category this month but under Spend Insights it is showing a different amount. Why is the amount different?
answer: - Transactions tracked under the preferred category are based on MCC while the transactions under Spend Insights have taken in others factors to determine the category. For example, ValueMax is under MCC 5933 – Pawn Shops hence it is not considered as Shopping category, but because they do sell jewelry and watches, they are categorised as Shopping under Spend Insights.

question: Will my Trust Link card transactions be counted towards the minimum spends for my Trust Cashback card and earn cashback?
answer: - No, if you spend on your Trust Link card, the transactions will be counted towards your Trust Link card spending and earn Linkpoints for your Eligible Spend. Similarly, if you spend on your Trust Cashback card, the transactions will be counted towards your Trust Cashback card spending and earn cashback for your Eligible Spend. You will be able to track your spend for your respective Trust cards under Rewards section.

question: What happened if I have pending transaction when closing my Cashback card? Will I get my cashback?
answer: - You will only be able to close your card when there is no pending transaction and no outstanding balance. Hence you will get your cashback on your other eligible spend before the card is closed.

question: When is the March - July Credit Card Acquisition Giveaway promotion period?
answer: - Promotion period will be from 1 Mar to 31 July 2026.

question: Will my Trust Cashback card transactions be counted towards my spend bonus interest on my Savings account?
answer: - Yes, your Trust Cashback card transactions will be counted towards the bonus interest on your Savings account.

question: Who is eligible to participate for the March - July Credit Card Acquisition Giveaway Promotion?
answer: - The Quest will be allocated to customers who have successfully signed up for their first credit card with Trust during the Promotion period.

question: Will transactions made via digital wallets such as Atome, ShopeePay, GrabPay, PayPal, or AliPay be eligible to earn cashback?
answer: - No, transactions made via digital wallets are typically assigned under MCC 6540, 7299 and 7399 which fall under the ineligible transactions and will not earn cashback. Please see “What are the ineligible transactions which are not eligible to earn cashback”

question: What do I need to do to take part in the March - July Credit Card Acquisition Giveaway promotion?
answer: - Make one Eligible Spend during the promotion period, as shown in your quest. Refer to the Quest that is allocated to you in your Trust App > Rewards > Quest.

question: What are the ineligible transactions which are not eligible to earn cashback?
answer: - The following are ineligible transactions: - Any cash advance. - Transactions on your credit card that are subsequently cancelled, voided, refunded or reversed or incurred by you but aren’t submitted or posted to your credit card. - AXS, SAM or ATM transactions made using your credit card. - Any insurance premiums. - Any fees (for example annual card fees, service fees, interest, administrative fees, finance fees, and/or late payment fees). - Amounts which have been rolled over from any preceding month’s statement. - Any top-ups or payment of funds to any accounts. - Any transaction classified under any of the following Merchant Category Codes: - Utilities, Rentals and Cleaning Services – 4900, 6513, 7349. - Financial Institutions, Securities – Brokers, Quasi Cash, Insurance, Stored Value Card Purchase/Load, Digital Wallets and Wire Transfer – 4829, 5960, 6010, 6011, 6012, 6051, 6211, 6300, 6540. - Gambling - 7995. - Educational Institutions – 8211, 8220, 8241, 8244, 8249, 8299. - Charitable services, political organisations, religious organisations and government payments – 8398, 8651, 8661, 9211, 9222, 9223, 9311, 9399, 9402, 9405. - Real Estate Agents and Managers – 6513. - Other services – 7299, 7399, 8999. - Any other fees or payments as we may decide.

question: What reward can I receive from March - July Credit Card Acquisition Giveaway Promotion?
answer: - You will receive 1 digital scratch card, in your Trust App under Rewards > Quests, after you complete the Quest during the promotion period.

question: Can I pair my Trust Cashback card with my Trust Savings account?
answer: - No, you can only pair your Trust Link card to your Trust Savings account.

question: What are the available rewards from this March - July Credit Card Acquisition Giveaway Promotion?
answer: - The digital scratch card will give you a chance to win one of these rewards: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB Deep Blue (S$1,899), Apple iPhone Air 256GB Sky Blue (S$1,599), Apple Watch SE 11 42mm GPS + Cellular Jet Black (S$739) or S$20 in FairPrice E‑Vouchers.

question: How do I get the $12 Caltex return voucher? How many Caltex return voucher can I get?

question: How are the monthly and quarterly caps on bonus rebates calculated?
answer: - The monthly cap on the monthly bonus rebates is based on your total FairPrice Group (FPG) spend in a calendar month. For instance, whether your card is approved on 1 July 2024 or 20 July 2024, your monthly cap for the month of July will be based on your total FPG spend in July 2024. The quarterly cap on the incremental quarterly bonus rebates is based on the first month that your card is approved for total FPG spend. For instance, if your card is approved on 10 July 2024, your quarterly cap will apply to your quarterly bonus rate earned on your total FPG spend from July to September 2024. However, if your card is approved on 30 August 2024, your quarterly cap will apply to your quarterly bonus rate earned on your total FPG spend from August to October 2024. question: Will my “Name on card” be the same for both cashback card and Link debit card if I am applying for both cards?

question: If I have both Trust Link credit and debit card, what will my rebate be based on?

question: Why is my transaction reflected as “Manual Debit” on my statement and there is no Linkpoints awarded for my transaction?
answer: - Your transaction was not processed and cleared automatically during settlement and had to be processed manually and debited to your card instead. We are unable to track transactions that were posted manually like the standard transactions thus we are unable to award any cashback or count it towards your minimum spend.

question: How does the card pairing work?
answer: - Card pairing is a feature that gives you the flexibility to pair your Trust Link card with either your Trust Link credit card account or savings account. Do note that it's only available for customers who own both products. If you would like to switch the pairing: - From Trust Link credit card account to savings account Tap the "Pair card" button in "View and manage card", and tap ‘Pair with savings account’. Subsequently, all transactions done on your card (including previous automatic payments) will be charged to your savings account. - From savings account to Trust Link credit card account Tap the “Pair card” button in “View and manage card”, and tap ‘Pair with credit card account’. Subsequently, all transactions done on your card (including previous automatic payments) will be charged to your credit card account. The transactions will be billed to you when your statement is ready. ATM cash withdrawals You have the option of selecting to withdraw cash from either your savings account or Trust Link credit card account at the ATM. The funds will then be withdrawn based on this selection. To avoid charges, we recommend that you pair your Trust Link card with savings account and select ‘Savings Account’ for ATM cash withdrawals so that they are withdrawn from your savings account even if there is no option to select to withdraw from your savings account at the ATM. If you choose to withdraw cash with your Trust Link credit card account, a cash advance fee (effective from 1 Feb 26) and cash advance interest will apply.

question: What process will my transaction undergo when I switch from Trust Link credit card to debit card (or vice versa) using the pair feature?
answer: - After you tap the "Pair with savings account" button in the Trust App, we'll send a push notification to confirm this change has been completed. Transactions When your card is linked to your Savings Account by Trust, all your new credit card transactions (including automatic payments previously set up on your Trust Link credit card while it was paired with credit card account) will be taken deducted from your savings account. Any transactions that were authorised before you tap the "Pair with savings account" button (i.e. those that appear as ‘pending’ in the Trust App) will still be processed as Trust Link credit card transactions on your credit card account. ATM cash withdrawals You have the option of selecting to withdraw cash from either your savings account or Trust Link credit card account at the ATM. The funds will then be withdrawn based on this selection. To avoid charges, we recommend that you select ‘Savings Account’ for ATM cash withdrawals so they are withdrawn from your savings account. If you choose to withdraw cash with your Trust Link credit card account, charges for cash advance will apply.

question: Will the pair feature still work if I close either my Trust Link credit card or debit card?
answer: - The pair feature is only available to customers with both Trust Link credit card and debit card/savings account. This means that if you close the Trust Link credit and/or debit card, the pair feature will no longer be available to you. After your Trust Link credit card is closed, all your future spending on your Trust Link card will be deducted from your Savings Account by Trust. Similarly, after your Trust Link debit card is closed, all your future spending on your Trust Link card will be deducted from your Trust Link credit account.

question: What happens to refunded transactions after I've used the pair feature on my Trust Link card?
answer: - If your transaction was still ‘pending’, the reversed amount will go to the Trust Link credit or debit card that you’ve used to make the transaction. However, if your transaction is ‘completed’, the refunded amount will go to the Trust Link credit or debit card that you are paired to at that point in time.

question: I made a transaction using my Trust Link debit card yesterday, can I pair it to my Trust Link credit card instead?
answer: - If the transaction has been authorised and is being processed, it can't be changed. That means the payment you've made will be charged to your Trust Link debit card.

question: After I tap 'pair', how long does it take for the change to take effect?
answer: - After tapping the pair feature, the change will take effect immediately and all future transactions will be charged into the Trust Link card you've paired to.

question: I just signed up for my NTUC Union membership. When will my NTUC Union membership status be reflected in Trust records?

question: How do I know if my NTUC Union membership status has been updated at Trust?
answer: - Once your NTUC Union membership status is updated at Trust, your digital card face in the Trust App will be updated to the NTUC Link Credit/Debit Card face.

question: Will my Trust Link card details be changed once my digital card face is updated in the Trust App?

question: I just signed up for my NTUC Union membership. Do I need to inform Trust?

question: I am holding on to the non-union card. When do I start enjoying the NTUC Link Credit/Debit Card benefits?

question: I see the NTUC Link Credit/Debit digital card on my app. Can I start to enjoy the NTUC Link Credit/Debit Card's benefits immediately?
answer: - You will only start to enjoy the NTUC Link Credit/Debit card benefits from the first day of the subsequent month when your card face has changed to the NTUC Link Credit/Debit digital card.

question: On my Trust App, the card is showing the NTUC Link Credit/Debit Card, but I am still holding on to the Trust Link Credit/Debit Card. Will the NTUC Link Credit/Debit Card be mailed to me?

Please note that with a lost card replacement, your card details including card number, CVV and expiry date will change and you will have to update your card details for any online credit card arrangements (card-on-file, recurring payments) that you may have.

question: Will I receive any notification to confirm my status change?
answer: - Yes, you will receive the confirmation of your Union status change via push notification and eDM.

question: What happens when I cancel my Union membership?

However, you will still be able to enjoy your NTUC Link Credit/ Debit card benefits till the end of the current month upon your cancellation. Your Trust Link Credit/ Debit card benefits will then take effect from the 1st of the subsequent month.

question: I have an existing Trust Link card. Will I receive a separate credit card statement for my Trust Cashback card?

For example, if you do not have any transaction(s) on your Trust Link card, you will only see your Trust Cashback card transactions in your statement. Similarly, if you only make transaction(s) on your Trust Link card, you will only see your Trust Link card transactions in your statement.

question: How far back can I access my credit card statements with my Trust App?

question: Can I really select any repayment date for my credit card during my application?

question: I have both a Trust Link card and Trust Cashback card. Can I pay off the outstanding balances on my Trust Link card only (or vice versa)?

question: How do I make payment from another bank account to pay off both my Trust Link card and Trust Cashback card?

question: How can I pay my Trust credit cards bill?
answer: - Pay using Trust savings account You can conveniently pay your Trust credit card bills from your Trust savings account: - Log in to the Trust App - Tap on ‘Money’ then ‘Credit Card’ then ‘Pay credit card’ - Your Savings Account should be shown. Select from the available options to make the payment. - Review the transfer details. If it is correct, swipe up to confirm. To check how to add money to your Trust savings account - https://trustbank.sg/faqs/savings-account/#how-do-i-deposit-money-into-my-savings-account Pay using other bank accounts You can also pay your Trust credit cards bill from your other bank accounts in two ways. Either by adding your Trust credit card number as a local transfer (also sometimes called FAST) or as a transfer to your credit card to make the repayment. Scroll down to see instructions on paying your Trust credit card bill using the banking apps from DBS/POSB, UOB, OCBC and Standard Chartered Bank. DBS/POSB Option 1: Add as a local recipient (payment is instant) - Tap Pay & Transfer > Local > Add Local Recipient > Bank Account - Enter Recipient’s name, select bank as Trust Bank Singapore Limited, and enter your 16-digit Trust card number under Recipient’s account number > Tap Next - Review Recipient’s details. If it is correct, tap on Add Recipient Now - You may have to perform additional verification at this point - Tap again on Pay & Transfer > Local.
