question: Can I schedule transfers to pay my credit card bills from other banks?
answer: - - Yes, you can schedule a one-time or a recurring local fund transfer, also known as Standing Instructions / Scheduled Transfers, from other banks to your Trust credit card to pay your credit card bills. - You may indicate your preferred date and / or frequency for the transfer and have Trust credit card as the recipient. - Do note that the amount is fixed for all recurring transfers in this setup.

question: Can I pay my credit card bill via AXS machine?
answer: - This option is currently not available. Please see the following question, How can I pay my Trust credit card bill? , for details steps on how to pay your credit card bill.

question: How long does it take to process the credit card bill payment from my Trust savings account?
answer: - The transfer will be processed in real time to your credit card and you’ll receive an immediate confirmation.

question: If I want to repay my credit card bill, do I need to pair back to my credit card before doing so?
answer: - This depends on the payment method you select in the other bank’s app. - If you choose to pay via local transfer / recipient (also known as FAST), there is no need to change your card pairing to a credit card before making the payment. - However, if you choose to pay via credit card payment, you will need to ensure your card is paired to your Trust Link credit card in order to repay your credit card bill. This helps ensure the payment is routed correctly based on the selected payment method. Please see the following question, How can I pay my Trust credit card bill? , for details steps on how to pay your credit card bill.

question: How do I set up recurring AutoPay transfers for my credit card repayments from my Trust savings account?
answer: - You can set up AutoPay by following the steps below: - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on ‘Credit Card’, ‘Pay card’ then ‘Trust Credit Card’ - Tap on ‘Set up’ from the AutoPay banner OR Tap on ‘Payments’, ‘AutoPay’ then ‘New AutoPay’ and ‘Trust Credit Card’ - Select repayment amount type - statement balance or minimum balance to schedule your future repayments - Select ‘Schedule AutoPay' Do note that for recurring AutoPay transfers for your Trust credit card repayment, it will be automatically deducted from your Trust savings account 2 days prior to your payment due date.

question: What is AutoPay?
answer: - AutoPay is a feature to - Pay your Trust credit card from your Trust savings account on a recurring basis - Transfer to your Trust savings pot(s) from your Trust savings account on a recurring basis - Make outgoing payments using PayNow on a recurring or one-off basis on future date(s) and - Pay other bank’s savings account or credit card on a recurring or one-off basis on a future date(s) By selecting your preferred payment amount, frequency and recurring period (start date and end date), scheduled payments will then be automatically deducted from your Trust savings account. For recurring AutoPay transfers for your Trust credit card repayment, it will be automatically deducted from your Trust savings account 2 days prior to your payment due date.

question: I have set up AutoPay, when will the scheduled payments start?
answer: - For paying your Trust credit card from Trust savings account - If your payment due date for that month is more than 2 days away, your first AutoPay schedule will start within the same month. - If your payment due date is less than 2 days away, your first AutoPay scheduled payment will only start next month. Do remember to make your own repayment for that month by the due date to avoid a late fee. For example: - Scenario 1: Payment due date is 5th of every month and today is January 2nd and customer sets up AutoPay. AutoPay is set to start in January with the first scheduled payment on January 3rd and recurring on February 3rd, March 3rd, etc. - Scenario 2: Payment due date is 5th of every month and today is January 3rd and customer sets up AutoPay. AutoPay is set to start in February with the first scheduled payment on February 3rd and recurring on March 3rd, April 3rd, etc. - Scenario 3: Payment due date is 5th of every month and today is January 4th when customer sets up AutoPay (same for January 5th). AutoPay is set to start in February with the first scheduled payment on February 3rd and recurring on March 3rd, April 3rd, etc. For other types of AutoPay, the scheduled payment will start on the schedule date that you have indicated. For example: - Scenario 1: If you set up a Weekly AutoPay and start date is on Wednesday, then your subsequent scheduled payment would be always on Wednesday - Scenario 2: If you set up a Monthly AutoPay and start date is on 5th of the starting month, then the subsequent payment would be on 5th of each upcoming month - Scenario 3: If you set up a Monthly AutoPay and start date is on last calendar day of the starting month, then the subsequent payment would be on the last calendar day of each upcoming month - Scenario 4: If you set up a Quarterly AutoPay and start date is on 5th July, then the subsequent payment would be on 5th October - Scenario 5: If you set up a Yearly AutoPay and start date is on 5th July, then the subsequent payment will be on 5th July of the next year

question: How do I disable my AutoPay for my Trust credit card?
answer: - For Trust credit card AutoPay, you may disable AutoPay by following the steps below: - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on ‘Pay card’ on your credit card tab - Tap on ‘View’ on AutoPay tab - Tap on ‘Disable AutoPay’ Do note that if your savings account is closed, the scheduled AutoPay would be automatically cancelled and no payment would be executed

question: When can I disable my AutoPay?
answer: - You may disable AutoPay anytime. AutoPay for credit card repayments If you disable AutoPay for credit card repayments, remember to make payments to avoid late fees. Example: - Scenario 1: payment due date is 5th of every month, scheduled payment is 3rd of the month and today is January 2nd when you disable AutoPay. AutoPay will be disabled from January 3rd onwards. In this scenario, you need to make a manual repayment. - Scenario 2: payment due date is 5th of every month, scheduled payment is 3rd of the month and today is January 3rd when you disable AutoPay. AutoPay will be disabled from February 3rd onwards. January scheduled payment will proceed as per normal. Other AutoPay types If today is the scheduled date and AutoPay is disabled today, today’s Autopay will still be executed. The disabling of AutoPay will only take effect from tomorrow onwards.

question: I have AutoPay set up for Minimum Amount Due, but I also made my own repayment to Trust credit card before AutoPay is processed for that month. Will the scheduled payment for Minimum Amount Due still be processed?
answer: - Yes, AutoPay will still process the same Minimum Amount Due as per your credit card statement, even if you have already made your own repayment.

question: I have an existing Trust Link card with Auto Pay set up. Do I need to update my Auto Pay set up?
answer: - You do not need to do anything. Auto Pay will continue to apply based on what you have set up. For example, if your payment due date is every 5th of the month and you have set up to repay based on your statement balance, the selected repayment amount will be transferred automatically from your Trust savings account to your card account on 3rd of the month.

question: Are zero fees (no annual fee, no foreign transaction fee, no card replacement fee and no overlimit fee) valid for a limited time only?
answer: - No, you can always enjoy zero fees as a Trust customer! For more information on late payment charges, go here .

question: What does zero FX fee or zero foreign transaction fee mean?
answer: - Trust does not charge any foreign transaction/markup fees, not even the usual 1% Visa charge. However, when using Trust card to pay for foreign transaction via payment platform like Alipay or WeChat Pay, the payment platform may charge a transaction service fee for payment made with international cards. Please refer to the relevant payment platform to check the applicable fee.

question: Will I be charged interest for purchases made on my credit card (excluding cash advance)?
answer: - No, it is interest-free, as long as you make a full repayment by your payment date or within 15 days after your credit card statement is generated.

question: What are the fees if I don't pay the minimum amount due?
answer: - Before 9 April 2026: If the minimum amount due is not received by the due date, a late payment fee of S$100 and any applicable interest will be charged. From 9 April 2026: If the minimum payment is not received by the due date, a late payment fee and any interest accrued will be charged to the main cardholder. - The standard late payment fee is S$100. - If your statement includes any loan instalment, the late payment fee is S$200. If there is more than one loan instalment (e.g., a Split Purchase and an Instant Loan) in the statement, the late payment fee will still be S$200. It does not increase with multiple instalments. “Loan instalment” refers to any product that involves periodic repayments charged to your credit card. This currently includes Instant Loan, Balance Transfer, Split Purchase, and Visa Instalments. Only loan instalments shown in your statement are considered. To view your statement balance or balance due: - Navigate to Home page - Tap 'Credit Cards' - Tap 'Statements' to view details For more details, please refer to the Everything on fees and interest section in the relevant credit card Key Facts Sheet here !

question: How is my personalised credit card EIR determined?
answer: - From 1 July 2026, your EIR will be personalised based on your credit behaviour. Your rate will range from 18.9% p.a. to 29.9% p.a.. Your EIR will be reviewed and may be adjusted every 6 months. If you hold more than one Trust credit card, the same EIR will apply across all your cards.

question: When will I be charged interest?
answer: - You will have 15 interest-free days to make payment after your next Credit Card statement is generated. If you do not make full payment of your statement balance by the payment due date, interest will be calculated daily at the prevailing rate of 27.9% p.a.* on (i) any unpaid balance (excluding fees and interest) from the last statement date until full payment is received (ii) any new transaction completed and posted after the last statement date until full payment is received. Any interest calculated will be accrued and billed to you on your next Credit Card statement. *From 1 July 2026, your Effective Interest Rate (EIR) will be personalised based on your credit behaviour. Your rate will range from 18.9% p.a. to 29.9% p.a. Interest also applies if you take a cash advance. You will be able to read everything on the relevant interest, fees and charges in this Key Fact Sheet here !

question: Where can I find my credit card EIR?
answer: - From 1 July 2026, you can view your personalised EIR anytime in the Trust app under Credit cards > Consolidated/View balance, or Credit cards > More.

question: Why did my credit card EIR change?
answer: - From 1 July 2026, your EIR will be reviewed every June and December based on your credit behaviour at the time of our assessment. If there is a change in your credit behaviour since the last review, your EIR may change in July and January. You will always be notified via email when your EIR changes.

question: What can I do to lower my EIR?
answer: - Healthy credit behaviour may help to keep your EIR low: - Pay your credit card bills and loan instalments on time - Make payments for statement balances in full - Don’t max out your credit cards - Avoid applying for too many credit cards and loans at once - Pay at least the minimum amount due by the payment due date each month on your credit card

question: How much does cash advance cost?
answer: - Effective from 1 Feb 26, a cash advance fee of 8% will be charged on the cash advance amount withdrawn. Amounts less than S$5 will not incur this fee. Interest charges calculated on a daily basis at 0.077% (27.9% p.a.)* on the amount withdrawn from the posting date until the full payment date. *From 1 July 2026, your Effective Interest Rate (EIR) will be personalised based on your credit behaviour. Your rate will range from 18.9% p.a. to 29.9% p.a.

question: Is there a card replacement fee?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this!

question: I missed my payment on both my Trust Link and Trust Cashback card. Will I be charged a late fee on each card?
answer: - As you would receive one consolidated card statement across all your Trust cards, if you missed the payment, you will be charged one late fee across both Trust cards.

question: Will a late payment fee be charged to my Trust credit card if my Standing Instructions / Scheduled Transfers from other bank(s) fail?
answer: - If there is any delay in paying your Trust credit card bill, you will be charged a late payment fee. To request for a waiver, please leave us a message via the Trust in-app chat indicating “fee waiver”. We’ll review your request and you’ll receive an update via push notification within 3 working days.

question: Will a returned GIRO fee be charged to my GIRO-linked account if my Standing Instructions / Scheduled Transfers from other bank(s) to my Trust credit card / savings account fail?
answer: - The imposing of a late fee is decided by the debiting bank. You may reach out to your debiting bank for further details. We apologise for the inconvenience.

question: How do I request for a fee waiver?
answer: - If you have been charged a late payment fee and would like to request for a waiver, please leave us a message via the Trust in-app chat indicating “fee waiver”. We’ll review your request and you’ll receive an update via push notification within 3 working days.

question: How do I know if my card is currently enabled or disabled for overseas usage?

question: Can I use my card overseas?

You can enable your physical card for overseas usage before you travel in a few easy steps: - Log in to your Trust App - Go to 'View Card' - Select ' Manage card settings ' - Under 'Physical card, contactless, ATM withdrawal', turn on the setting for Overseas use Do note that you will need to first activate your physical card if it's new, replaced or renewed.

question: What's the difference between magnetic stripe and EMV chip transactions?
answer: - The magnetic stripe behind your physical credit card contains your credit card information and is easy to clone. On the other hand, the EMV chip on the front of your card contains a microprocessor chip that uses encryption to prevent its contents from being replicated. The EMV chip card complies with the Monetary Authority of Singapore's enhanced standard of data security and offers better protection against fraudulent activities. For magnetic stripe transactions, the merchant sales staff will swipe your card. However, for EMV chip transactions, your card will be inserted into a point-of-sale (POS) terminal.

question: How do I disable my credit card for overseas usage?
answer: - You can disable your physical credit card for overseas usage in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Go to 'View Card' 3. Select 'Transaction controls' 4. Turn off the setting for Overseas use under 'Physical card and contactless use'

question: If I choose to replace my existing Trust Link Credit/Debit Card with the lost card replacement option, can I still use my physical Trust Link Credit/Debit Card to earn Linkpoints in the meantime?
answer: - No, you will not be able to use your existing physical Trust Link Credit/Debit Card to earn Linkpoints after the lost card replacement option is selected. You will only be able to use your new NTUC Link Credit/Debit Card to earn Linkpoints when you do receive it or use the FairPrice app, by adding the new NTUC Link Credit/Debit Card details available on your Trust App in the meantime.

question: I did not make a transaction on my card, but I got charged. How do I raise a dispute?

question: I would like to apply for a Trust supplementary card. Where can I get one?

The supplementary cardholder will then receive an invite which they can accept by going to Trust App > More > More for you, then tap on 'View invite'.

question: My Trust Cashback card was recently approved. Can I apply for Supplementary Card?
answer: - The Supplementary card is offered on the Trust Link credit card only.

question: Am I still entitled to the same benefits if the credit limit on my credit card is S$500?
answer: - Yes. You are entitled to the same benefits. See the Key Facts Sheet (in our app or on our website) for full details that apply to your card.

question: How do I earn up to 20% fuel savings on my Trust Link credit card?
answer: - You will enjoy the following: 17% upfront discount + 0.22% Linkpoints rebate on the nett transaction amount + 3.5% rebate on nett transaction amount if you meet the minimum monthly spend for your card. Do note that the 3.5% rebate will be subjected to the respective card's monthly Linkpoints cap.

question: How do I earn 17.1% fuel savings on my Trust Link debit card?

question: What is Trust’s partner and affiliate web application for?
answer: - Now you can seamlessly apply for Trust products through our partners' or affiliates' (e.g. FairPrice Group) app or website. There’s no need to download Trust App. Simply apply for a Link Credit Card or Cashback Credit Card via a secure Trust Bank web page through our partners' or affiliates' app or website. Note: Product availability may vary by partner or affiliates.

question: How does Trust web application work?
answer: - You can apply for a Trust credit card through our partners' or affiliates' app or website: - Your application will be completed on a secure Trust Bank web page - Use Myinfo to pre-fill your application form effortlessly - You'll receive real-time updates on your application status, unless additional actions are required in Trust App

question: Can new or existing Trust customers apply for a product via web application?
answer: - Yes, both new and existing Trust customers can apply for a product via web application. For example, if you are an existing Trust customer with savings account applying for Trust Link Credit Card, you can apply for a Link credit card via our partner’s or affiliate’s app or website.

question: What if I already have a Trust product? Can I still apply for a product that I do not hold via web application?
answer: - Yes, if you’re applying for a product that you don't currently hold, you can proceed with the web application via our partner’s or affiliate’s app or website.

question: What happens after I submit my application via a partner/affiliate app or website?
answer: - You'll be notified on your application outcome instantly via email/SMS: - For approved applications: You’ll receive instructions via your registered email to login to Trust App and activate your card - For unsuccessful application: You'll receive an email/SMS notification informing you of the outcome - If further action is required: In cases where your application decision isn’t immediate or additional documents are required, we’ll send you an email with instructions on how to log in to Trust App to check your application status or upload the necessary documents

question: My credit card is approved via the web application, but I haven’t downloaded Trust App yet. How can I start using my card?
answer: - Once your card is approved, you’ll need to download Trust App and log in using MyInfo to activate your credit card. After logging in, you can: - View your digital card details immediately - Activate your physical card once it arrives in your mailbox Your physical card will be delivered to your registered mailing address within 7 business days after your application is approved.

question: Can I skip downloading Trust App?
answer: - No. Downloading Trust App is required to activate your credit card and manage your account.

question: Is my data safe during the web application?
answer: - Yes. All personal data is securely managed within Trust Bank’s ecosystem. Our partners or affiliates do not have access to your sensitive information during the web application.

question: What if I encounter an error or session timeout?
answer: - If you see an error page or your session expires (after 20 minutes of inactivity), try refreshing the web page and restarting the application process. Alternatively, you can download Trust App to apply for a product directly. If the issue persists, please contact our Customer Care team for assistance.

question: Which browsers are supported for web application?
answer: - Our web application uses MyInfo for authentication and supports the following browsers: - On desktop : - Chrome (version 114 and above) - Firefox (version 115 and above) - Edge (version 114 and above) - Safari (version 16 and above) - On mobile : - Safari (version 16 and above) - Chrome (version 114 and above) Note: Older browser versions may not be supported. Please ensure you're using the latest version for the best experience.

question: I am an existing Trust customer and have activated Kill Switch. Can I  apply for a credit card via a partner/affiliate app or website?
answer: - If your Kill Switch is active, you won’t be able to submit your web application for security reasons. Instead, you’ll be redirected to Trust App. To deactivate Kill Switch, please call us at +65 313-TRUST (+65 3138 7878). Our Customer Care Team will authenticate your identity and update our system records so that you can proceed with your application.

question: What happens if I started my web application but accidentally closed the browser page?
answer: - You'll need to restart your application if you have closed or exited your browser page. Alternatively, you can also download Trust App to apply for a product directly.

question: I applied for a Trust credit card via the web. How can I access more details about my Trust account?
answer: - Please download Trust App and log in using MyInfo. Make sure your MyInfo is ready for a smooth first login. Once you're logged in, Trust App gives you full access to manage your credit card including: - Viewing your card details (card number, expiry date, CVV) - Activating your physical card - Locking or unlocking your card - Adding your card to Apple Wallet - Changing your credit limit

question: My web application has been approved. Where do I view my card details (such as card number, expiry and CVV)?
answer: - Once your card is approved, you'll need to download Trust App and log in using MyInfo to access your credit card details including your 16-digit card number, expiry date, and CVV. You can also add your digital card to Apple Wallet for easy and secure payments.

question: I submitted my card application via Trust App, but it's still pending. Can I submit a new application via the web? Will my previous application be cancelled?
answer: - Yes, you can submit a new application via the web as long as your previous application hasn't been successfully processed. Once you submit a new application, your previous application via Trust App will be automatically cancelled. However, if your previous application has already been successfully processed, you’ll be redirected to Trust App to login.

question: How can I check the status of my web application?
answer: - You'll be notified of your application outcome via SMS or email. For new customers after logging into Trust App: - If your application is approved, you’ll be directed to the home screen - If your application is declined, pending or requires further action, you’ll see a screen showing the outcome or next steps For existing customers, you can: - View your product holdings on Trust App home screen - Check the status under the “Apply” section if your application is still in progress

question: I received an email confirming my application is approved, but I'm having trouble logging into Trust App using Myinfo. What should I do?
answer: - Please reach out to our Customer Care Team at +65 313-TRUST (+65 3138 7878) for assistance. Our team will be happy to guide you through the login process.

question: What is Instant Loan?
answer: - Instant Loan is a bank loan in Singapore that allows you to convert a portion of your Trust credit card available credit balance into cash.

question: Am I eligible for Instant Loan?
answer: - For existing customers, - You must have a Trust credit card to be eligible for Instant Loan and have sufficient available credit limit For new customers, - Singaporean Citizens, Permanent Residents and Foreigners are currently eligible for Instant Loan - All loan applications will be subjected to the bank’s credit checks for loan eligibility. You can apply for a credit facility if: - You are between 21 years old and 65 years old; and - Have an annual income of S$30,000 if Singaporean citizen or permanent resident; or - Have an annual income of S$60,000 if foreigner with a valid work pass

question: How do I apply for Instant Loan?
answer: - You can apply for Instant Loan via our app. Simply tap on Trust App > Money > Loan to get started, or download Trust App and tap on Product Selection > Instant Loan, if you’re a new customer.

question: What are the fees for taking up Instant Loan?
answer: - There are no annual fees for loans taken before 25 February 2026. Loans taken from 25 February 2026: We charge 0.88% first year annual fee on your loan amount to your credit card. For loan tenures of one year or longer, a $50 fee is charged on the anniversary of each Instant Loan you have with us, if the monthly minimum payment due on your credit card is not received by the due date for the preceding 12 consecutive calendar months.

question: What are the fees for closing the loan early?
answer: - We charge a 3% early repayment fee on your outstanding principal amount when you repay early.

question: How long will it take for my loan to be approved?
answer: - Most loans will be approved and deposited to your Trust savings account within 60 seconds.

question: How do I repay my loan?
answer: - Your loan instalment will be charged to your credit card bill every month, which you can pay through your credit card statement. Simply tap on Trust App > Money > Credit Card > Pay credit card

question: Why is the interest rate on my app different?
answer: - The interest rate offered to you is based on your loan amount, loan tenure and personal credit profile. Hence it may differ from the one displayed on our website.

question: What happens if I don’t make full payment on my loan instalment amount?
answer: - If you don't pay the full amount due on or before the payment due date, the unpaid principal of the instalment amount will be charged a daily interest of 0.077% (27.9% p.a.)* until the date the payment is received. *From 1 July 2026, your credit card Effective Interest Rate (EIR) will be personalised based on your credit behaviour. Your rate will range from 18.9% p.a. to 29.9% p.a.

question: How is my loan monthly instalment calculated?
answer: - Each instalment amount is calculated based on the sum of (a) the approved loan amount and (b) the total interest over the loan tenure, divided by the number of months of the loan tenure. For more information, please refer to Instant Loan T&Cs.

question: What is Effective Interest Rate (EIR)?
answer: - EIR reflects the true cost of borrowing. It factors in the reducing principal balance over the tenure of the loan and the total charges, including the first year annual fees.

question: When I apply for Instant Loan as a new customer, which products am I applying for?
answer: - As part of your Instant Loan application, you are applying for a credit card and savings account.

question: Why do I get a credit card and savings account with my Instant Loan application?
answer: - The bank will convert a portion of your Trust credit card available balance into cash, which will be deposited into your savings account.

question: When I apply for Instant Loan as a new customer, will I be able to select my desired credit card limit?
answer: - Yes, you’re able to select your desired credit card limit when you apply for Instant Loan. Do note that your credit limit will need to be greater than your Instant Loan amount you are requesting for.

question: My Instant Loan application was declined, will I still be eligible to apply for other products (such as credit card and savings account)?
answer: - Yes, you can still apply for other products. You will need to re-submit a new application based on the product of your choice.

question: What do I need to apply for Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - All you need is your mobile phone and MyInfo authentication to pre-fill your application form effortlessly. Do note that should you delete or reinstall your Trust App after successfully signing up, SingPass will still be required to authenticate yourself when you re-login.

question: Can I open a Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - You may apply for the Savings Account by Trust if you are: 1. Singapore citizen, Singapore permanent resident or foreigner with a valid work pass; and 2. 16 years old and above

question: How long does the application take?
answer: - It only takes a few minutes. However, if we need to contact you for clarifications, it may take up to 5 working days.

question: What is the minimum age for opening a Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - 16 years old and above.

question: Where can I find my account number?
answer: - You can view your account number in a few easy steps: - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on 'Savings'. You will be able to view your account number in the main account card after “Main -” - To copy your account number, tap on the Main card and click the copy icon in the “Trust savings account number” panel

question: How do I deposit money into my savings account?
answer: - Option 1 - using bank transfer (via FAST) Step 1 Log in to your other bank account Step 2 Add your Trust savings account as a local recipient, enter your recipient name and Trust savings account number. Step 3 Make a transfer and that’s it! Option 2 - add money using PayNow Step 1 De-register your mobile number or NRIC/FIN if you have registered PayNow with another bank account Step 2 Tap on Payments tab > Have you registered for PayNow? Step 3 Complete the PayNow registration and make a PayNow transfer to your registered mobile number or NRIC/ FIN and that's it!

question: What is the Signature plan?
answer: - With the Signature plan, you can earn an interest rate of up to 1% p.a. on your deposit balance up to the first S$1.2 million. This consists of: - Base interest of 0.05% p.a. (no conditions); - Spend bonus interest of 0.2% p.a. (if you are a NTUC Union member) or 0.1% p.a. (for non-Union member) with 5 x S$30 qualifying card transactions posted within the month, - Balance bonus interest of 0.3% p.a. with S$100K Average Daily Balance (ADB) for the month, and - Salary bonus interest of 0.45% p.a. if you credit minimum salary of S$1,500 in a single transaction through GIRO within the month. Balances above S$1.2 million will earn 0.05% p.a. interest. Your interest will be credited on the last day of the month.

question: What is the Flex plan?
answer: - With the Flex plan, you can personalise the way you earn interest. In addition to earning a base interest of 0.05% p.a. (no conditions), choose 3 out of 8 bonus interest criteria from the following: - Referral bonus interest of 1.20% p.a. if you successfully refer at least one new Trust credit card customer who gets approved within the month. A new Trust credit card customer is a customer who does not have an existing or cancelled Trust account - Invest bonus interest of 0.70% p.a. if you purchase new investments in cumulative purchase cost of S$20K total or more in eligible funds. Eligible funds exclude Cash+ funds, and your buy order(s) need to be executed by the second last business day of the month - Salary bonus interest of 0.45% p.a. if you credit minimum salary of S$1,500 in a single transaction through GIRO with purpose code SALA within the month - Balance bonus interest of 0.3% p.a. with S$100K Average Daily Balance (ADB) for the month - Spend bonus interest of 0.2% p.a. (if you are a Union member) or 0.1% p.a. (for non-Union member) with 5x S$30 qualifying card transactions posted within the month - Incoming PayNow bonus interest of 0.15% p.a. if you receive at least S$1,500 total incoming PayNow transfers to your Trust savings account within the month - FX spend bonus interest of 0.15% p.a. if you make at least S$500 total qualifying FX card spends posted within the month - Savings increase bonus interest of 0.2% p.a. if you increase your saving account’s ADB by at least S$3K from the previous month’s ADB

question: What is the Zen plan?
answer: - The Zen plan gives you a flat interest rate of 0.4% p.a. on your deposit balances up to the first S$1.2 million. Enjoy a fuss-free plan to earn interest with no bonus criteria to fulfil!

question: How much interest will I earn on my Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - The interest that you earn depends on the savings plan that you have chosen. If you have not chosen a plan, you will automatically get the Signature plan. Under the Signature plan, you can get a high interest rate of up to 1% p.a. on the first S$1,200,000 deposit balance in your savings account. This is made up of base interest of 0.05% p.a (no conditions); Spend bonus interest of 0.2% p.a. (if you are a Union member) or 0.1% p.a. (for non-Union member) with 5 qualifying card transactions, Balance bonus interest of 0.3% p.a. with S$100K Average Daily Balance (ADB) for the month, and Salary bonus interest of 0.45% p.a. if you credit minimum salary of S$1,500 in a single transaction through GIRO with purpose code SALA within the month. Balances above S$1,200,000 will earn 0.05% p.a. interest. Your interest will be credited on the last day of the month. Balance Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.3% x 31/365 = S$305.75 (you get bonus interest for the full month!) Salary Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.45% x 31/365 = S$458.63 (you get bonus interest for the full month!)
