Balance Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.3% x 31/365 = S$305.75 (you get bonus interest for the full month!) Salary Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.45% x 31/365 = S$458.63 (you get bonus interest for the full month!) Next S$25K: Base: S$25,000 x 0.05% x 31/365 = S$1.06 Total interest = S$918.30 Calculations are simplified for illustration purposes

question: What are the 3 plans for Trust savings account?
answer: - You can now enjoy the flexibility of choosing a savings plan to earn interest on the deposit balances in your savings account. There are 3 savings plans available: Signature, Zen and Flex. You can change your savings plan anytime before the end of the month, and your last selection will be effective from the 1st of the next month. You will receive a push and email notification every time you successfully change your plan. You can check which savings plan is currently active by going to Trust App > Savings > Interest this month. You can also track your progress towards earning the selected bonus interests on this screen. If you do not change your plan during the month, the current plan will automatically continue for the next month.

question: What can I use the Savings Account by Trust for?
answer: - The Savings Account by Trust is a Singapore dollar (SGD) account for your savings and everyday transactions. With this account, you can: - Save in SGD currency - Pay for your purchases in SGD with your Trust card or through PayNow QR - Withdraw money at any Standard Chartered ATM with Trust card - Transfer or receive SGD to or from other bank accounts (via FAST/PayNow/incoming GIRO/Salary crediting) - Make repayment to yourTrust credit card outstanding balances by setting up autopay or on an ad hoc basis

question: What are the features and benefits of the savings account?
answer: - Grow your savings your way You can now choose a preferred savings plan to earn interest on your deposit balances! Enjoy an interest rate of up to 2.4% on the first S$1,200,000 deposit balance. Balances above S$ 1,200,000 will earn 0.05% p.a. interest. No more fees Absolutely zero hidden fees! Say goodbye to minimum balance or fall-below fee, monthly service fee, account closure fee, FX fee and debit card annual fee. Your very own debit card Receive a debit card with these fantastic features: - Instant digital card: No waiting needed. You'll receive a digital card instantly for e-commerce transactions before your physical card arrives - Physical card activation via NFC or code: NFC allows you to simply scan your card by holding it to the back of your phone to activate it automatically. We are the first bank in Singapore to introduce this NFC capability! If you do not have a NFC-enabled phone, fret not – you can activate your card using the activation code found in your welcome pack - PIN set up: Choose a 6-digit PIN for your card on your Trust App to securely access ATM transactions - Numberless card: This protects your card against theft and fraud. You can access your card number easily via your Trust App Easy access to your cash Withdraw money from your savings account at our ATM located within FairPrice Xtra VivoCity or any Standard Chartered ATM.

question: Will I receive notification alerts on transactions in my account?
answer: - Yes, you'll be informed of all incoming and outgoing account or card transactions instantly via in-app push notifications and email notifications.

question: When will interest be paid into my account?
answer: - On the last day of the month.

question: How often is interest paid into my account?
answer: - Interest will be paid monthly.

question: Can I open more than one savings account?
answer: - You can only open one Savings Account.

question: Can I open a joint-named savings account?
answer: - For now, you can open a savings account in your name only.

question: Is there a monthly fee for the Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this!

question: Is there a fall-below fee for the Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this!

question: Will I be charged a fee if I close my account?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this! However, any interest accrued in the month of account closure will not be credited.

question: Will I be charged an annual fee for the debit card by Trust?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this!

question: Where can I find my monthly statements?
answer: - You can view or download your monthly statements in a few easy steps. - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on 'Savings' and select 'Deposit' - Select […] and then 'Statements' on the menu

question: Will I be notified when my statement is ready?
answer: - Yes, you'll receive an email notification on the day it's ready. The statement for the current month will be generated within the next month.

question: Can I access my old past statements?
answer: - Yes, you can access up to 7 years of statements via your Trust App.

question: How do I qualify for spend bonus interests? What counts as eligible transactions?
answer: - Make at least 5 qualifying card transactions of minimum S$30 each with your Trust Card to unlock this Spend bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1,200,000. Transactions need to be posted within the month to be eligible. Note that the following transactions do not qualify: - transactions arising from the use of your Trust card as an ATM card at an EFTPOS terminal; - balance transfers to your Trust card; - paying online bills using your savings account; - payments to loans or credit facilities or deposit accounts; - top-ups of any stored value facility; - paying bills at AXS using your savings account; - any fees and charges (including annual fees, interest charges, administrative fees, cash advance fees, finance charges and/or late payment charges and other miscellaneous fees and charges) charged to your linked Trust card; - balance owing on your Trust card from previous or other months; and - betting and gambling related transactions - any other transactions charged to your linked Trust card as we may determine from time to time. Base interest and bonus interest will be computed on a daily basis and based on a 365-day year.

question: Is there a promo interest rate for Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - At the moment, there is no promo interest rate for Savings Account by Trust.

question: Where can I find ATM to withdraw cash?
answer: - You can easily withdraw cash from Trust / Standard Chartered Bank (SCB)’s ATM located across the island as well as overseas ATM with Visa enabled. You can find a Trust-branded ATM at FairPrice Xtra Vivocity, #B2-23 and SCB ATMs at Bedok Mall, Bugis Junction, Vivocity, Sixth Avenue, Clementi Mall, NEX Serangoon, Serangoon Garden, Marine Parade, Changi Business Park, Tampines, Marina Bay Financial Centre and Battery Road. (Further details can be found at ATM Branch Locator ).

question: What is the PIN to use for ATM cash withdrawal and can I reset it?
answer: - You can use your card PIN for ATM cash withdrawal. If you've not set up or wish to reset the PIN, you can do so via Trust App.

question: Is there any charge for Trust or SCB ATM usage?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this!

question: Do I need to pair my card to savings account for cash withdrawal from my Trust savings account?
answer: - No, you don't need to change your card pairing to savings account. For withdrawal of cash at ATM, the option you select at the ATM will determine which account the cash will be drawn from. For example, if you wish to withdraw from your Trust savings account, please select savings account at ATM. However, we recommend that you pair your card to your savings account so that even if there is no option to select to withdraw from your savings account at the ATM, the cash withdrawal will be withdrawn from your savings account. Do note that cash withdrawals under credit account option are cash advances and will incur a cash advance fee (effective from 1 Feb 26) and interest charges.

question: What is the maximum ATM cash withdrawal limit?
answer: - There is a per transaction limit of S$2,000 at Trust/ SCB ATM. Total cash withdrawal in last 24 hours is capped at S$5,000 (across local and overseas withdrawals), subject to available balance in your account.

question: Can I withdraw from ATM5 network?
answer: - No, Trust card can only be used at Standard Chartered Bank and Trust ATM at the moment.

question: The cash amount dispensed is incorrect. What should I do?
answer: - Please contact Trust Customer Care Team via Trust App to investigate the issue.

question: I have withdrawn money from Trust ATM but the receipt shows SCB logo/URL/hotline. Why is that so?
answer: - Trust ATM is powered by Standard Chartered Bank to service Trust customers.

question: My card is being retained by the ATM machine. What should I do?
answer: - Please request for a card replacement via Trust App or contact Trust Customer Care Team.

question: Can I withdraw cash from overseas ATM and are there any charges for it?
answer: - Yes, you can withdraw cash from an overseas ATMs with Visa enabled. Please look out for overseas ATMs with VISA – Plus logo that accepts 6-digit PIN as our Trust Cards only function with a 6-digit PIN. Remember to turn on the overseas usage for “Physical card and contactless use” under card transaction controls in your Trust app. Please note that the overseas bank that operates the ATM may charge a fee. Note: If you hold both a Trust Link credit card account and a savings account, we recommend that you pair your card with savings account and select ‘Savings Account’ at the ATM during cash withdrawals so that they are withdrawn from your savings account even if there is no option to select to withdraw from your savings account at the ATM. Do note that cash withdrawals under credit card account option are cash advances and will incur a cash advance fee (effective from 1 Feb 26) and interest charges.

question: Can I choose the currency to be charged when I’m withdrawing cash from overseas ATM?
answer: - Some overseas ATMs may offer you the choice to be charged in SGD, which is known as Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC), or the local currency when withdrawing cash from the ATM. You are encouraged to withdraw in the local currency as the exchange rate is generally better compared to the one imposed by the foreign ATM provider.

question: How do I raise a dispute on ATM transactions (e.g. cash amount dispersed is incorrect)
answer: - Please contact Trust Customer Care Team via in-app chat or call for dispute resolution.

question: Which account type to select for ATM cash withdrawal?
answer: - If you hold both a Trust Link credit card account and a savings account, please pair your Trust Link card with your savings account and select savings account for ATM cash withdrawal from your Trust savings account, so that they are withdrawn from your savings account. Do note that cash withdrawals under credit account option are cash advances and will incur a cash advance fee (effective from 1 Feb 26) and interest charges.

question: What will happen if I accidentally withdraw cash from my Trust Link credit card instead of my savings account? What should I do next to avoid interest charges?
answer: - Please make full payment immediately to pay off all your balances including your unbilled transactions that are not shown in your statement to avoid incurring interest charges. For example, 1 May Outstanding balance from last statement - $250.00 12 May Total Unbilled balance - $15.50 12 May Cash Advance withdrawal - $300.00 Total payment to be made - $565.50

question: How can I pay my Trust credit card bill from Trust savings account?
answer: - You can conveniently pay your Trust credit card bill from your Trust savings account: - Log in to the Trust App - Tap on ‘Credit Card’ then ‘Pay card’ - Your Savings Account should be shown. Select from the available options to make the payment. - You can also setup AutoPay to avoid any late payment

question: How long does it take to process the credit card bill payment from my Trust savings account?
answer: - The transfer will be processed in real time to your credit card and you’ll receive an immediate confirmation.

question: How do I know if I'm qualified for bonus interest?
answer: - How do I know if I'm qualified for bonus interest - Login to Trust App - Tap on ‘Savings’ - Tap on 'Interest this month' For Balance Bonus and Savings Increase Bonus, your Average Daily Balance is calculated after the last day of the month. The in-app tracker will show a half-tick if you are on track to qualify.

question: How do I qualify for Incoming PayNow bonus interest?
answer: - Receive at least S$1,500 in total incoming PayNow transfers to your Trust savings account to unlock this bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1.2 million. To receive incoming PayNow transfers, you'll need to register your NRIC/FIN or mobile number with Trust through the app.

question: How do I qualify for Referral bonus interest?
answer: - Successfully refer at least one new Trust credit card customer who gets approved in the month using your referral code to unlock this bonus The person whom you have referred must not have an existing, closed or cancelled Trust account(s).

question: How do I qualify for FX Spend bonus interest?
answer: - Make at least S$500 total FX card spends to unlock the FX Spend bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1.2 million. FX card spends are transactions charged in foreign currency and need to be posted within the month to be eligible. Note that the following transactions do not qualify: - transactions arising from the use of your Trust card as an ATM card at an EFTPOS terminal; - balance transfers to your Trust card; - paying online bills using your savings account; - payments to loans or credit facilities or deposit accounts; - top-ups of any stored value facility; - paying bills at AXS using your savings account; - any fees and charges (including annual fees, interest charges, administrative fees, cash advance fees, finance charges and/or late payment charges and other miscellaneous fees and charges) charged to your linked Trust card; - balance owing on your Trust card from previous or other months; and - betting and gambling related transactions - any other transactions charged to your linked Trust card as we may determine from time to time.

question: How do I qualify for Savings Increase bonus interest?
answer: - Increase your Average Daily Balance (ADB) by at least S$3,000 from the previous month’s ADB to unlock this bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1.2 million. Average Daily Balance is the sum of daily balances divided by the number of days in the month. Please note that this is not the same as the end-of-month balance.

question: How do I qualify for Invest bonus interest?
answer: - Purchase new investments in total of S$20K or more in eligible funds via TrustInvest*. Eligible funds exclude Cash+ funds. Your buy order(s) need to be executed by the second last business day of the month to unlock this bonus for the month. *The funds invested and money in your investment account are not insured by SDIC. The money in your investment account does not earn any interest.

question: How do I qualify for balance bonus interests?
answer: - Maintain a minimum S$100,000 Average Daily Balance (ADB) for the month to unlock this Balance bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1,200,000.

question: When will I receive Spend /Balance /Salary bonus interest?
answer: - All bonus interests will be credited on the last day of the month, together with base interest.

question: How  can I check my current ADB?
answer: - You can view your current ADB in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App and tap on your profile icon on the top right 2. Tap on Trust+ 3. Tap on "S$100K total balances to qualify”

question: What is Average Daily Balance (ADB)?
answer: - Average Daily Balance is the sum of daily balances divided by the number of days in the month.

question: Do I qualify for balance bonus interest if I only open my savings account mid-month?
answer: - Yes, average daily balance (ADB) will be calculated based on the day your savings account is opened and you will qualify for balance bonus interest when you maintain a min S$100,000 ADB for the month.

question: What is Savings Pots?
answer: - Savings pots are sub-accounts that allow you to organise and set aside money for different purposes. You can create up to 5 Saving Pots and set a goal and target completion date.

question: Can I withdraw after I created a Savings Pot / goal?
answer: - Yes, you can transfer money from Savings Pots to your main account and vice versa anytime, anywhere.

question: What is the interest rates applicable on Savings Pots?
answer: - Balances in your Savings Pots will earn the same interest rates as your main account. Interests will be calculated based on the total balances in main account and Savings Pots at the prevailing interest rates, and credited to the main account at the end of each month.

question: Can I transfer money to (or receive money from) other parties using my Savings Pots?
answer: - You can only transfer money to (or receive money from) other parties using your main account. You will not be able to transfer money to (or receive money from) other parties/banks using your Savings Pots.

question: How do I set up recurring AutoPay transfers for Trust saving pots from my Trust savings account?
answer: - You can set up AutoPay by following the steps below: - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on ‘Deposit’ then ‘Savings Pot’ - Tap on the Savings Pot that you would like to set up AutoPay with - Tap on ‘Schedule AutoPay’ - Select start date, end date, frequency of transfer and amount - Tap on ‘Confirm’, and Auto Pay will be set up successfully OR - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on ‘Payments’ then ‘AutoPay’ - Tap on ‘New AutoPay’ then ‘AutoPay to Savings Pot’ - Select the Savings Pot to set up AutoPay - Select start date, end date, frequency of transfer and amount - Tap on ‘Confirm’, and Auto Pay will be set up successfully Do note that AutoPay transfers will be automatically deducted from your Trust savings account based on the scheduled start date.

question: Can I use the money in Savings Pots for spends and payments transactions?
answer: - Debit card spends, AutoPay to Trust credit card, FAST/ PayNow transactions will be deducted from your main account only. Please remember to maintain or transfer sufficient funds in your main account for these transactions.

question: How do I qualify for Salary bonus interest?
answer: - Credit minimum salary of S$1,500 through GIRO in a single transaction with purpose code "SALA" to unlock this Salary bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1,200,000. Salary credited through FAST will not be eligible.

question: Why do I receive message that my Trust savings account is getting deactivated?
answer: - This is due to your Trust savings account having been inactive for some time. To safeguard your account, we've temporarily deactivated your account. You'll not be able to login to Trust App or use your Trust debit card until it has been reactivated.

question: How do I reactivate my Trust savings account?
answer: - To reactivate your account, please login to your Trust App for re-authentication. You can regain your Trust account in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Tap on the Singpass QR code for authentication (ensure you have the Singpass app) and authenticate your Singpass account 3. For post authentication, set up your new 6-digit passcode.

question: What is Trust Lock?
answer: - Trust Lock is an in-app security feature that allows you to lock money in your savings account via Savings Pots, providing an additional layer of security for your funds from potential frauds and scams. Your funds cannot be used for any transactions until you unlock them using your Trust card and with your phone’s Near Field Communication (NFC)) feature. Alternatively, you can also choose to unlock this manually by visiting our TEC (Trust Experience Center) for manual verification.

question: What is NFC technology?
answer: - Near Field Communication (NFC) is a wireless technology that allows two devices to communicate when they are placed close together. In the case of Trust Lock, your Trust card is used to interact with your NFC-enabled phone to unlock funds securely.

question: How does Trust Lock work?
answer: - It’s simple! First, create a new Savings Pot and transfer the amount you wish to lock from your savings account into that Savings Pot. When you activate Trust Lock, your funds in the Savings Pot will be locked. You will not be able to withdraw funds from a locked Savings Pot until you unlock it. You can create multiple Savings Pots and lock each of them too. To unlock them, you can either: - Use your Trust card by tapping it on your NFC-enabled phone, followed by entering your Trust Key, or - Visit our TEC (Trust Experience Center) in person for manual verification, if you do not have an active card or if you don't have an NFC-enabled phone.

question: Why should I use Trust Lock?
answer: - Trust Lock provides an extra layer of protection by combining both account-level protection and NFC technology . Your money remains locked unless you unlock it with your Trust card and NFC-enabled phone, or through in-person verification at TEC.

question: How do I activate Trust Lock?
answer: - To activate Trust Lock, simply log into your Trust App and go to ‘Deposit’ > ‘More’ > ‘Trust lock’. If you do not have a Savings Pot, you can create one, add funds and activate Trust Lock. If you have an existing Savings Pots, you can select the ‘Trust Lock’ option on your respective Savings Pot to lock your pot and confirm the activation.

question: How do I unlock my money in Savings Pot?
answer: - You can choose the Savings Pot you wish to unlock and select the ‘Unlock’ option . Due to enhanced security, you will need to perform the following steps: - Verify your active Trust card with a NFC-enabled phone - Verify your Trust Key - Wait for a 12-hour cooling period Alternatively, you can submit a request via y our app to verify in-person and bring your NRIC/FIN to Trust Experience Center at FairPrice Xtra VivoCity. Once verified, your money will be unlocked instantly. Trust Experience Centre is located at FairPrice Xtra VivoCity, #B2-23. We’re open between 11.00am to 3.00pm and 3.30pm to 7.00pm daily! At Level B2 of Vivocity, head towards FairPrice Xtra and turn left after entering. The Trust Experience Centre is located directly opposite the checkout cashiers.

question: Why is the NFC not responding after I scan with my Trust card to unlock Trust lock?
answer: - Please check that you are scanning with your Trust card. On Android phones, the NFC area is at the back of the phone. It is usually in the center, and sometimes slightly higher. On iOS phones, the NFC area is at the top edge of the device. Tap your Trust card on the NFC spot and hold the card against the phone for 1-2 seconds. Upon successful reading, you will see a tick icon. If it is still not responding after holding it for 1-2 seconds, please try other spots or check your specific device model online to find the NFC spot.

question: How long do I need to wait to withdraw my funds, after unlocking my Savings Pot via the app?
answer: - You will need to wait for a 12-hour cooling period before you can withdraw your funds. When the cooling period is over, you will receive a notification that you can withdraw money from your Savings Pot. Note: The 12-hour cooling period will not apply for manual unlocking performed at TEC. Unlocking of Savings Pot is instant once your identity has been verified.

question: Can I still unlock my Savings Pot without my Trust card or NFC-enabled phone?
answer: - If you do not have an NFC-enabled phone and an active Trust card, you will not be able to unlock your Savings Pot via the app. Instead, you will need to submit a request via Trust App to bring your NRIC/FIN to TEC (Trust Experience Center) for in-person verification to manually unlock your Savings Pot. [If you walk-in and request manual unlocking without sending a request, you may experience delays.]

question: What happens if my Trust card is self-locked/not activated when I wish to unlock my Savings Pot?
answer: - If your Trust card is locked by yourself or not activated yet, please proceed to unlock or activate your card via the app before unlocking your Savings Pot. Alternatively, you can visit TEC to verify in-person and manually unlock your funds.

question: What happens if my Trust card is lost/damaged when I wish to unlock my Savings Pot?
answer: - If your Trust card is lost/damaged, please proceed to request for a replacement card via the app or calling our hotline. You will not be able to use a damaged card to unlock your locked funds until you receive a new card (a valid and active Trust card is required). Alternatively, you can visit our TEC to verify in-person and manually unlock your funds. See FAQ on “ How do I unlock my money in Savings Pot?”.

question: Is there a limit to how much I can lock using Trust Lock?
answer: - No, there is no limit. You can choose to lock all the funds in your savings account if desired. However, it is recommended to keep a portion of your funds unlocked for emergencies or regular transactions.

question: Can I activate Trust Lock for multiple Savings Pots?
answer: - Yes, you can!! And rest easy! Your locked funds continue to earn interest that is credited to your main account.

question: Can I choose how much funds to lock in my Savings Pots?
answer: - Yes, you can select the exact amount of money to lock within your Savings Pots. This gives you the flexibility to secure a specific portion of your savings, while keeping the rest of your balance accessible.

question: Is there a time limit on how long my money can be locked?
answer: - No, there is no fixed time limit for how long your money can remain locked. You have full control and can unlock it any time by using your Trust card with NFC technology or by visiting TEC for manual verification.

question: Is there a fee for using Trust Lock and unlocking my Savings Pot at TEC?
answer: - No. It is a free service to provide an extra layer of security to protect your funds from potential scams!

question: Can I still fund my Savings Pot if I locked it?
answer: - Yes! You can continue to fund your Savings Pot even when Trust Lock is activated. However, you will need to deactivate Trust Lock to withdraw money from your locked pot.

question: Will I earn a referral fee if I refer my friend to a Trust product?
answer: - From 1 July onward, when you refer a friend, you will receive: - S$8 cashback for each successful Trust Savings Account referral - S$18 cashback for each successful Credit Card referral

question: I've received a referral code. What do I need to do? What benefits do I get?
answer: - Enter the referral code you received under “Use Referral Code” at the start of your application. When you refer a friend, you will receive: - S$8 cashback for each successful Trust Savings Account referral - S$18 cashback for each successful Credit Card referral

question: What are the prizes available in the Scratch cards?
answer: - You will receive a fixed cashback amount depending on the product that your friend signs up for. You will receive: - S$8 cashback for each successful Trust Savings Account referral - S$18 cashback for each successful Credit Card referral

question: How will the cashback from my Scratch card be credited to me?
answer: - Depending on which Trust product(s) you have, the cashback will be credited to your account in the following priority order: - Trust Cashback card - Trust Link or NTUC Link Credit Card - Savings Account by Trust

question: I've received a number of referral codes from different people. What's the difference between each code and are they safe to use?
answer: - Rest assured that all of the codes are safe to use, each referral code is tied to a different promotion — feel free to use the one that suits you best! Remember, you can only use 1 referral code!

question: How do I participate in the referral program?
answer: - Open your Trust App, head over to your profile and tap on the "Invite Friends" to share your referral code with your family and friends.

question: How do I view my referral code?
answer: - Open your Trust App, head over to your profile and tap on the "Invite Friends" to view your referral code.

question: Where can I download the Trust App from?
answer: - The Trust App can only be downloaded from the official Apple App Store or Google Play Store.

question: What do I need to apply for Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - All you need is your mobile phone and MyInfo authentication to pre-fill your application form effortlessly. Do note that should you delete or reinstall your Trust App after successfully signing up, SingPass will still be required to authenticate yourself when you re-login.

question: Can I open a Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - You may apply for the Savings Account by Trust if you are: 1. Singapore citizen, Singapore permanent resident or foreigner with a valid work pass; and 2. 16 years old and above

question: How long does the application take?
answer: - It only takes a few minutes. However, if we need to contact you for clarifications, it may take up to 5 working days.

question: What is the minimum age for opening a Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - 16 years old and above.

question: Where can I find my account number?
answer: - You can view your account number in a few easy steps: - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on 'Savings'. You will be able to view your account number in the main account card after “Main -” - To copy your account number, tap on the Main card and click the copy icon in the “Trust savings account number” panel

question: How do I deposit money into my savings account?
answer: - Option 1 - using bank transfer (via FAST) Step 1 Log in to your other bank account Step 2 Add your Trust savings account as a local recipient, enter your recipient name and Trust savings account number. Step 3 Make a transfer and that’s it! Option 2 - add money using PayNow Step 1 De-register your mobile number or NRIC/FIN if you have registered PayNow with another bank account Step 2 Tap on Payments tab > Have you registered for PayNow? Step 3 Complete the PayNow registration and make a PayNow transfer to your registered mobile number or NRIC/ FIN and that's it!

question: What is the Signature plan?
answer: - With the Signature plan, you can earn an interest rate of up to 1% p.a. on your deposit balance up to the first S$1.2 million. This consists of: - Base interest of 0.05% p.a. (no conditions); - Spend bonus interest of 0.2% p.a. (if you are a NTUC Union member) or 0.1% p.a. (for non-Union member) with 5 x S$30 qualifying card transactions posted within the month, - Balance bonus interest of 0.3% p.a. with S$100K Average Daily Balance (ADB) for the month, and - Salary bonus interest of 0.45% p.a. if you credit minimum salary of S$1,500 in a single transaction through GIRO within the month. Balances above S$1.2 million will earn 0.05% p.a. interest. Your interest will be credited on the last day of the month.

question: What is the Flex plan?
answer: - With the Flex plan, you can personalise the way you earn interest. In addition to earning a base interest of 0.05% p.a. (no conditions), choose 3 out of 8 bonus interest criteria from the following: - Referral bonus interest of 1.20% p.a. if you successfully refer at least one new Trust credit card customer who gets approved within the month. A new Trust credit card customer is a customer who does not have an existing or cancelled Trust account - Invest bonus interest of 0.70% p.a. if you purchase new investments in cumulative purchase cost of S$20K total or more in eligible funds. Eligible funds exclude Cash+ funds, and your buy order(s) need to be executed by the second last business day of the month - Salary bonus interest of 0.45% p.a. if you credit minimum salary of S$1,500 in a single transaction through GIRO with purpose code SALA within the month - Balance bonus interest of 0.3% p.a. with S$100K Average Daily Balance (ADB) for the month - Spend bonus interest of 0.2% p.a. (if you are a Union member) or 0.1% p.a. (for non-Union member) with 5x S$30 qualifying card transactions posted within the month - Incoming PayNow bonus interest of 0.15% p.a. if you receive at least S$1,500 total incoming PayNow transfers to your Trust savings account within the month - FX spend bonus interest of 0.15% p.a. if you make at least S$500 total qualifying FX card spends posted within the month - Savings increase bonus interest of 0.2% p.a. if you increase your saving account’s ADB by at least S$3K from the previous month’s ADB

question: What is the Zen plan?
answer: - The Zen plan gives you a flat interest rate of 0.4% p.a. on your deposit balances up to the first S$1.2 million. Enjoy a fuss-free plan to earn interest with no bonus criteria to fulfil!

question: How much interest will I earn on my Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - The interest that you earn depends on the savings plan that you have chosen. If you have not chosen a plan, you will automatically get the Signature plan. Under the Signature plan, you can get a high interest rate of up to 1% p.a. on the first S$1,200,000 deposit balance in your savings account. This is made up of base interest of 0.05% p.a (no conditions); Spend bonus interest of 0.2% p.a. (if you are a Union member) or 0.1% p.a. (for non-Union member) with 5 qualifying card transactions, Balance bonus interest of 0.3% p.a. with S$100K Average Daily Balance (ADB) for the month, and Salary bonus interest of 0.45% p.a. if you credit minimum salary of S$1,500 in a single transaction through GIRO with purpose code SALA within the month. Balances above S$1,200,000 will earn 0.05% p.a. interest. Your interest will be credited on the last day of the month. Illustration: If you meet the following criteria: maintain a deposit balance of S$1,225,000 daily for the month of Dec completed 5 qualifying card transactions of minimum $30 each on 5 Dec have $2,000 salary credited on 20 Dec your interest earned for the month of Dec is: Union Member: First S$1.2M: Base: S$1,200,000 x 0.05% x 31/365 = S$50.95 Spend Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.2% x 31/365 = S$203.83 (you get bonus interest for the full month!) Balance Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.3% x 31/365 = S$305.75 (you get bonus interest for the full month!) Salary Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.45% x 31/365 = S$458.63 (you get bonus interest for the full month!) Next S$25K: Base: S$25,000 x 0.05% x 31/365 = S$1.06 Total interest = S$1,020.22 Non-Union Member: First S$1.2M: Base: S$1,200,000 x 0.05% x 31/365 = S$50.95 Spend Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.1% x 31/365 = S$101.91 (you get bonus interest for the full month!) Balance Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.3% x 31/365 = S$305.75 (you get bonus interest for the full month!) Salary Bonus: S$1,200,000 x 0.45% x 31/365 = S$458.63 (you get bonus interest for the full month!) Next S$25K: Base: S$25,000 x 0.05% x 31/365 = S$1.06 Total interest = S$918.30 Calculations are simplified for illustration purposes

question: What are the 3 plans for Trust savings account?
answer: - You can now enjoy the flexibility of choosing a savings plan to earn interest on the deposit balances in your savings account. There are 3 savings plans available: Signature, Zen and Flex. You can change your savings plan anytime before the end of the month, and your last selection will be effective from the 1st of the next month. You will receive a push and email notification every time you successfully change your plan. You can check which savings plan is currently active by going to Trust App > Savings > Interest this month. You can also track your progress towards earning the selected bonus interests on this screen. If you do not change your plan during the month, the current plan will automatically continue for the next month.

question: What can I use the Savings Account by Trust for?
answer: - The Savings Account by Trust is a Singapore dollar (SGD) account for your savings and everyday transactions. With this account, you can: - Save in SGD currency - Pay for your purchases in SGD with your Trust card or through PayNow QR - Withdraw money at any Standard Chartered ATM with Trust card - Transfer or receive SGD to or from other bank accounts (via FAST/PayNow/incoming GIRO/Salary crediting) - Make repayment to yourTrust credit card outstanding balances by setting up autopay or on an ad hoc basis

question: What are the features and benefits of the savings account?
answer: - Grow your savings your way You can now choose a preferred savings plan to earn interest on your deposit balances! Enjoy an interest rate of up to 2.4% on the first S$1,200,000 deposit balance. Balances above S$ 1,200,000 will earn 0.05% p.a. interest. No more fees Absolutely zero hidden fees! Say goodbye to minimum balance or fall-below fee, monthly service fee, account closure fee, FX fee and debit card annual fee. Your very own debit card Receive a debit card with these fantastic features: - Instant digital card: No waiting needed. You'll receive a digital card instantly for e-commerce transactions before your physical card arrives - Physical card activation via NFC or code: NFC allows you to simply scan your card by holding it to the back of your phone to activate it automatically. We are the first bank in Singapore to introduce this NFC capability! If you do not have a NFC-enabled phone, fret not – you can activate your card using the activation code found in your welcome pack - PIN set up: Choose a 6-digit PIN for your card on your Trust App to securely access ATM transactions - Numberless card: This protects your card against theft and fraud. You can access your card number easily via your Trust App Easy access to your cash Withdraw money from your savings account at our ATM located within FairPrice Xtra VivoCity or any Standard Chartered ATM.

question: Will I receive notification alerts on transactions in my account?
answer: - Yes, you'll be informed of all incoming and outgoing account or card transactions instantly via in-app push notifications and email notifications.

question: When will interest be paid into my account?
answer: - On the last day of the month.

question: How often is interest paid into my account?
answer: - Interest will be paid monthly.

question: Can I open more than one savings account?
answer: - You can only open one Savings Account.

question: Can I open a joint-named savings account?
answer: - For now, you can open a savings account in your name only.

question: Is there a monthly fee for the Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this!

question: Is there a fall-below fee for the Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this!

question: Will I be charged a fee if I close my account?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this! However, any interest accrued in the month of account closure will not be credited.

question: Will I be charged an annual fee for the debit card by Trust?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this!

question: Where can I find my monthly statements?
answer: - You can view or download your monthly statements in a few easy steps. - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on 'Savings' and select 'Deposit' - Select […] and then 'Statements' on the menu

question: Will I be notified when my statement is ready?
answer: - Yes, you'll receive an email notification on the day it's ready. The statement for the current month will be generated within the next month.

question: Can I access my old past statements?
answer: - Yes, you can access up to 7 years of statements via your Trust App.

question: How do I qualify for spend bonus interests? What counts as eligible transactions?
answer: - Make at least 5 qualifying card transactions of minimum S$30 each with your Trust Card to unlock this Spend bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1,200,000. Transactions need to be posted within the month to be eligible. Note that the following transactions do not qualify: - transactions arising from the use of your Trust card as an ATM card at an EFTPOS terminal; - balance transfers to your Trust card; - paying online bills using your savings account; - payments to loans or credit facilities or deposit accounts; - top-ups of any stored value facility; - paying bills at AXS using your savings account; - any fees and charges (including annual fees, interest charges, administrative fees, cash advance fees, finance charges and/or late payment charges and other miscellaneous fees and charges) charged to your linked Trust card; - balance owing on your Trust card from previous or other months; and - betting and gambling related transactions - any other transactions charged to your linked Trust card as we may determine from time to time. Base interest and bonus interest will be computed on a daily basis and based on a 365-day year.

question: Is there a promo interest rate for Savings Account by Trust?
answer: - At the moment, there is no promo interest rate for Savings Account by Trust.

question: Where can I find ATM to withdraw cash?
answer: - You can easily withdraw cash from Trust / Standard Chartered Bank (SCB)’s ATM located across the island as well as overseas ATM with Visa enabled. You can find a Trust-branded ATM at FairPrice Xtra Vivocity, #B2-23 and SCB ATMs at Bedok Mall, Bugis Junction, Vivocity, Sixth Avenue, Clementi Mall, NEX Serangoon, Serangoon Garden, Marine Parade, Changi Business Park, Tampines, Marina Bay Financial Centre and Battery Road. (Further details can be found at ATM Branch Locator ).

question: What is the PIN to use for ATM cash withdrawal and can I reset it?
answer: - You can use your card PIN for ATM cash withdrawal. If you've not set up or wish to reset the PIN, you can do so via Trust App.

question: Is there any charge for Trust or SCB ATM usage?
answer: - No, there are absolutely zero fees for this!

question: Do I need to pair my card to savings account for cash withdrawal from my Trust savings account?
answer: - No, you don't need to change your card pairing to savings account. For withdrawal of cash at ATM, the option you select at the ATM will determine which account the cash will be drawn from. For example, if you wish to withdraw from your Trust savings account, please select savings account at ATM. However, we recommend that you pair your card to your savings account so that even if there is no option to select to withdraw from your savings account at the ATM, the cash withdrawal will be withdrawn from your savings account. Do note that cash withdrawals under credit account option are cash advances and will incur a cash advance fee (effective from 1 Feb 26) and interest charges.

question: What is the maximum ATM cash withdrawal limit?
answer: - There is a per transaction limit of S$2,000 at Trust/ SCB ATM. Total cash withdrawal in last 24 hours is capped at S$5,000 (across local and overseas withdrawals), subject to available balance in your account.

question: Can I withdraw from ATM5 network?
answer: - No, Trust card can only be used at Standard Chartered Bank and Trust ATM at the moment.

question: The cash amount dispensed is incorrect. What should I do?
answer: - Please contact Trust Customer Care Team via Trust App to investigate the issue.

question: I have withdrawn money from Trust ATM but the receipt shows SCB logo/URL/hotline. Why is that so?
answer: - Trust ATM is powered by Standard Chartered Bank to service Trust customers.

question: My card is being retained by the ATM machine. What should I do?
answer: - Please request for a card replacement via Trust App or contact Trust Customer Care Team.

question: Can I withdraw cash from overseas ATM and are there any charges for it?
answer: - Yes, you can withdraw cash from an overseas ATMs with Visa enabled. Please look out for overseas ATMs with VISA – Plus logo that accepts 6-digit PIN as our Trust Cards only function with a 6-digit PIN. Remember to turn on the overseas usage for “Physical card and contactless use” under card transaction controls in your Trust app. Please note that the overseas bank that operates the ATM may charge a fee. Note: If you hold both a Trust Link credit card account and a savings account, we recommend that you pair your card with savings account and select ‘Savings Account’ at the ATM during cash withdrawals so that they are withdrawn from your savings account even if there is no option to select to withdraw from your savings account at the ATM. Do note that cash withdrawals under credit card account option are cash advances and will incur a cash advance fee (effective from 1 Feb 26) and interest charges.

question: Can I choose the currency to be charged when I’m withdrawing cash from overseas ATM?
answer: - Some overseas ATMs may offer you the choice to be charged in SGD, which is known as Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC), or the local currency when withdrawing cash from the ATM. You are encouraged to withdraw in the local currency as the exchange rate is generally better compared to the one imposed by the foreign ATM provider.

question: How do I raise a dispute on ATM transactions (e.g. cash amount dispersed is incorrect)
answer: - Please contact Trust Customer Care Team via in-app chat or call for dispute resolution.

question: Which account type to select for ATM cash withdrawal?
answer: - If you hold both a Trust Link credit card account and a savings account, please pair your Trust Link card with your savings account and select savings account for ATM cash withdrawal from your Trust savings account, so that they are withdrawn from your savings account. Do note that cash withdrawals under credit account option are cash advances and will incur a cash advance fee (effective from 1 Feb 26) and interest charges.

question: What will happen if I accidentally withdraw cash from my Trust Link credit card instead of my savings account? What should I do next to avoid interest charges?
answer: - Please make full payment immediately to pay off all your balances including your unbilled transactions that are not shown in your statement to avoid incurring interest charges. For example, 1 May Outstanding balance from last statement - $250.00 12 May Total Unbilled balance - $15.50 12 May Cash Advance withdrawal - $300.00 Total payment to be made - $565.50

question: How can I pay my Trust credit card bill from Trust savings account?
answer: - You can conveniently pay your Trust credit card bill from your Trust savings account: - Log in to the Trust App - Tap on ‘Credit Card’ then ‘Pay card’ - Your Savings Account should be shown. Select from the available options to make the payment. - You can also setup AutoPay to avoid any late payment

question: How long does it take to process the credit card bill payment from my Trust savings account?
answer: - The transfer will be processed in real time to your credit card and you’ll receive an immediate confirmation.

question: How do I know if I'm qualified for bonus interest?
answer: - How do I know if I'm qualified for bonus interest - Login to Trust App - Tap on ‘Savings’ - Tap on 'Interest this month' For Balance Bonus and Savings Increase Bonus, your Average Daily Balance is calculated after the last day of the month. The in-app tracker will show a half-tick if you are on track to qualify.

question: How do I qualify for Incoming PayNow bonus interest?
answer: - Receive at least S$1,500 in total incoming PayNow transfers to your Trust savings account to unlock this bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1.2 million. To receive incoming PayNow transfers, you'll need to register your NRIC/FIN or mobile number with Trust through the app.

question: How do I qualify for Referral bonus interest?
answer: - Successfully refer at least one new Trust credit card customer who gets approved in the month using your referral code to unlock this bonus The person whom you have referred must not have an existing, closed or cancelled Trust account(s).

question: How do I qualify for FX Spend bonus interest?
answer: - Make at least S$500 total FX card spends to unlock the FX Spend bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1.2 million. FX card spends are transactions charged in foreign currency and need to be posted within the month to be eligible. Note that the following transactions do not qualify: - transactions arising from the use of your Trust card as an ATM card at an EFTPOS terminal; - balance transfers to your Trust card; - paying online bills using your savings account; - payments to loans or credit facilities or deposit accounts; - top-ups of any stored value facility; - paying bills at AXS using your savings account; - any fees and charges (including annual fees, interest charges, administrative fees, cash advance fees, finance charges and/or late payment charges and other miscellaneous fees and charges) charged to your linked Trust card; - balance owing on your Trust card from previous or other months; and - betting and gambling related transactions - any other transactions charged to your linked Trust card as we may determine from time to time.

question: How do I qualify for Savings Increase bonus interest?
answer: - Increase your Average Daily Balance (ADB) by at least S$3,000 from the previous month’s ADB to unlock this bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1.2 million. Average Daily Balance is the sum of daily balances divided by the number of days in the month. Please note that this is not the same as the end-of-month balance.

question: How do I qualify for Invest bonus interest?
answer: - Purchase new investments in total of S$20K or more in eligible funds via TrustInvest*. Eligible funds exclude Cash+ funds. Your buy order(s) need to be executed by the second last business day of the month to unlock this bonus for the month. *The funds invested and money in your investment account are not insured by SDIC. The money in your investment account does not earn any interest.

question: How do I qualify for balance bonus interests?
answer: - Maintain a minimum S$100,000 Average Daily Balance (ADB) for the month to unlock this Balance bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1,200,000.

question: When will I receive Spend /Balance /Salary bonus interest?
answer: - All bonus interests will be credited on the last day of the month, together with base interest.

question: How  can I check my current ADB?
answer: - You can view your current ADB in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App and tap on your profile icon on the top right 2. Tap on Trust+ 3. Tap on "S$100K total balances to qualify”

question: What is Average Daily Balance (ADB)?
answer: - Average Daily Balance is the sum of daily balances divided by the number of days in the month.

question: Do I qualify for balance bonus interest if I only open my savings account mid-month?
answer: - Yes, average daily balance (ADB) will be calculated based on the day your savings account is opened and you will qualify for balance bonus interest when you maintain a min S$100,000 ADB for the month.

question: What is Savings Pots?
answer: - Savings pots are sub-accounts that allow you to organise and set aside money for different purposes. You can create up to 5 Saving Pots and set a goal and target completion date.

question: Can I withdraw after I created a Savings Pot / goal?
answer: - Yes, you can transfer money from Savings Pots to your main account and vice versa anytime, anywhere.

question: What is the interest rates applicable on Savings Pots?
answer: - Balances in your Savings Pots will earn the same interest rates as your main account. Interests will be calculated based on the total balances in main account and Savings Pots at the prevailing interest rates, and credited to the main account at the end of each month.

question: Can I transfer money to (or receive money from) other parties using my Savings Pots?
answer: - You can only transfer money to (or receive money from) other parties using your main account. You will not be able to transfer money to (or receive money from) other parties/banks using your Savings Pots.

question: How do I set up recurring AutoPay transfers for Trust saving pots from my Trust savings account?
answer: - You can set up AutoPay by following the steps below: - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on ‘Deposit’ then ‘Savings Pot’ - Tap on the Savings Pot that you would like to set up AutoPay with - Tap on ‘Schedule AutoPay’ - Select start date, end date, frequency of transfer and amount - Tap on ‘Confirm’, and Auto Pay will be set up successfully OR - Log in to your Trust App - Tap on ‘Payments’ then ‘AutoPay’ - Tap on ‘New AutoPay’ then ‘AutoPay to Savings Pot’ - Select the Savings Pot to set up AutoPay - Select start date, end date, frequency of transfer and amount - Tap on ‘Confirm’, and Auto Pay will be set up successfully Do note that AutoPay transfers will be automatically deducted from your Trust savings account based on the scheduled start date.

question: Can I use the money in Savings Pots for spends and payments transactions?
answer: - Debit card spends, AutoPay to Trust credit card, FAST/ PayNow transactions will be deducted from your main account only. Please remember to maintain or transfer sufficient funds in your main account for these transactions.

question: How do I qualify for Salary bonus interest?
answer: - Credit minimum salary of S$1,500 through GIRO in a single transaction with purpose code "SALA" to unlock this Salary bonus for the full month on your deposit balance up to S$1,200,000. Salary credited through FAST will not be eligible.

question: Why do I receive message that my Trust savings account is getting deactivated?
answer: - This is due to your Trust savings account having been inactive for some time. To safeguard your account, we've temporarily deactivated your account. You'll not be able to login to Trust App or use your Trust debit card until it has been reactivated.

question: How do I reactivate my Trust savings account?
answer: - To reactivate your account, please login to your Trust App for re-authentication. You can regain your Trust account in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Tap on the Singpass QR code for authentication (ensure you have the Singpass app) and authenticate your Singpass account 3. For post authentication, set up your new 6-digit passcode.

question: What is Trust Lock?
answer: - Trust Lock is an in-app security feature that allows you to lock money in your savings account via Savings Pots, providing an additional layer of security for your funds from potential frauds and scams. Your funds cannot be used for any transactions until you unlock them using your Trust card and with your phone’s Near Field Communication (NFC)) feature. Alternatively, you can also choose to unlock this manually by visiting our TEC (Trust Experience Center) for manual verification.

question: What is NFC technology?
answer: - Near Field Communication (NFC) is a wireless technology that allows two devices to communicate when they are placed close together. In the case of Trust Lock, your Trust card is used to interact with your NFC-enabled phone to unlock funds securely.

question: How does Trust Lock work?
answer: - It’s simple! First, create a new Savings Pot and transfer the amount you wish to lock from your savings account into that Savings Pot. When you activate Trust Lock, your funds in the Savings Pot will be locked. You will not be able to withdraw funds from a locked Savings Pot until you unlock it. You can create multiple Savings Pots and lock each of them too. To unlock them, you can either: - Use your Trust card by tapping it on your NFC-enabled phone, followed by entering your Trust Key, or - Visit our TEC (Trust Experience Center) in person for manual verification, if you do not have an active card or if you don't have an NFC-enabled phone.

question: Why should I use Trust Lock?
answer: - Trust Lock provides an extra layer of protection by combining both account-level protection and NFC technology . Your money remains locked unless you unlock it with your Trust card and NFC-enabled phone, or through in-person verification at TEC.

question: How do I activate Trust Lock?
answer: - To activate Trust Lock, simply log into your Trust App and go to ‘Deposit’ > ‘More’ > ‘Trust lock’. If you do not have a Savings Pot, you can create one, add funds and activate Trust Lock. If you have an existing Savings Pots, you can select the ‘Trust Lock’ option on your respective Savings Pot to lock your pot and confirm the activation.

question: How do I unlock my money in Savings Pot?
answer: - You can choose the Savings Pot you wish to unlock and select the ‘Unlock’ option . Due to enhanced security, you will need to perform the following steps: - Verify your active Trust card with a NFC-enabled phone - Verify your Trust Key - Wait for a 12-hour cooling period Alternatively, you can submit a request via y our app to verify in-person and bring your NRIC/FIN to Trust Experience Center at FairPrice Xtra VivoCity. Once verified, your money will be unlocked instantly. Trust Experience Centre is located at FairPrice Xtra VivoCity, #B2-23. We’re open between 11.00am to 3.00pm and 3.30pm to 7.00pm daily! At Level B2 of Vivocity, head towards FairPrice Xtra and turn left after entering. The Trust Experience Centre is located directly opposite the checkout cashiers.

question: Why is the NFC not responding after I scan with my Trust card to unlock Trust lock?
answer: - Please check that you are scanning with your Trust card. On Android phones, the NFC area is at the back of the phone. It is usually in the center, and sometimes slightly higher. On iOS phones, the NFC area is at the top edge of the device. Tap your Trust card on the NFC spot and hold the card against the phone for 1-2 seconds. Upon successful reading, you will see a tick icon. If it is still not responding after holding it for 1-2 seconds, please try other spots or check your specific device model online to find the NFC spot.

question: How long do I need to wait to withdraw my funds, after unlocking my Savings Pot via the app?
answer: - You will need to wait for a 12-hour cooling period before you can withdraw your funds. When the cooling period is over, you will receive a notification that you can withdraw money from your Savings Pot. Note: The 12-hour cooling period will not apply for manual unlocking performed at TEC. Unlocking of Savings Pot is instant once your identity has been verified.

question: Can I still unlock my Savings Pot without my Trust card or NFC-enabled phone?
answer: - If you do not have an NFC-enabled phone and an active Trust card, you will not be able to unlock your Savings Pot via the app. Instead, you will need to submit a request via Trust App to bring your NRIC/FIN to TEC (Trust Experience Center) for in-person verification to manually unlock your Savings Pot. [If you walk-in and request manual unlocking without sending a request, you may experience delays.]

question: What happens if my Trust card is self-locked/not activated when I wish to unlock my Savings Pot?
answer: - If your Trust card is locked by yourself or not activated yet, please proceed to unlock or activate your card via the app before unlocking your Savings Pot. Alternatively, you can visit TEC to verify in-person and manually unlock your funds.

question: What happens if my Trust card is lost/damaged when I wish to unlock my Savings Pot?
answer: - If your Trust card is lost/damaged, please proceed to request for a replacement card via the app or calling our hotline. You will not be able to use a damaged card to unlock your locked funds until you receive a new card (a valid and active Trust card is required). Alternatively, you can visit our TEC to verify in-person and manually unlock your funds. See FAQ on “ How do I unlock my money in Savings Pot?”.

question: Is there a limit to how much I can lock using Trust Lock?
answer: - No, there is no limit. You can choose to lock all the funds in your savings account if desired. However, it is recommended to keep a portion of your funds unlocked for emergencies or regular transactions.

question: Can I activate Trust Lock for multiple Savings Pots?
answer: - Yes, you can!! And rest easy! Your locked funds continue to earn interest that is credited to your main account.

question: Can I choose how much funds to lock in my Savings Pots?
answer: - Yes, you can select the exact amount of money to lock within your Savings Pots. This gives you the flexibility to secure a specific portion of your savings, while keeping the rest of your balance accessible.

question: Is there a time limit on how long my money can be locked?
answer: - No, there is no fixed time limit for how long your money can remain locked. You have full control and can unlock it any time by using your Trust card with NFC technology or by visiting TEC for manual verification.

question: Is there a fee for using Trust Lock and unlocking my Savings Pot at TEC?
answer: - No. It is a free service to provide an extra layer of security to protect your funds from potential scams!

question: Can I still fund my Savings Pot if I locked it?
answer: - Yes! You can continue to fund your Savings Pot even when Trust Lock is activated. However, you will need to deactivate Trust Lock to withdraw money from your locked pot.

question: How is the Trust App secure?
answer: - We take pride in using multi-level security procedures, including tools and techniques for encryption, identity verification and fraud prevention and real time monitoring. This helps us to protect your account, transactions and personal information. Your Trust App is protected by multi-factor authentication and your app can only be paired to one smartphone and one phone number at any one time. This requires two methods of authentication as standard – considered to be the most secure way to protect yourself online.

question: Does my Trust card support 3DSecure?
answer: - Yes, we do! You'll be prompted to use it when specific merchants request that you use 3DSecure when making online transactions.

question: Does Trust monitor suspicious transactions?
answer: - Yes, Trust monitors all card transactions and mobile activities 24/7. If we detect suspicious activities on your account, we will reach you by in-app notification to verify the transaction.

question: What is phishing?
answer: - Phishing is the fraudulent attempt to obtain sensitive information such as usernames, passwords, and card details by disguising oneself as a trustworthy entity in an electronic communication (e.g. email). For example, phishing emails will almost always tell you to click on a link that takes you to a site which imitate true brands, such as our Trust brand, where your personal information is requested. In addition to fraudulent emails/websites, scammers can also establish fraudulent mobile applications imitating our brand to compromise your accounts and trick you in divulging your personal information.

question: What to do if things seem phishing?
answer: - If you receive a suspicious email/phone call claiming to be from us or unauthorised access or transactions on your account, please contact our Customer Care Team via the following ways immediately: The voice call or live chat function in your Trust App Hotline at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 )

question: I don't recognise this payment. What can I do to get more information?
answer: - If you are not sure if a transaction is legitimate, please contact us via the following ways and we’ll investigate. The voice call or live chat function in your Trust App Hotline at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 )

question: I lost my Trust card. What should I do?
answer: - If you have misplaced your Trust card, you can temporarily lock your Trust card in the app by following the steps below: Log in to the Trust App On the card home screen, tap "View and Manage card" Select "Lock card" If your Trust card is lost or has been stolen, make sure to first lock the Trust card and then report it as lost in the app: Log in to the Trust App On the card home screen, tap "View and Manage card" Select "Lock card" and "Replace Card" Trust will send you a new card and permanently deactivate the old card. You can also consider reporting the loss to the police. When a lost card is reported and replaced, you will be issued a new card number. Please remember to change any recurring transactions (e.g. your mobile subscription) to your new card number. For assistance, feel free to contact us in the app by selecting “Contact us” in the menu.

question: How to report suspicious/ fraudulent activities?
answer: - If you suspect you’ve been the victim of fraud, you should lock your Trust card and get in touch with us as soon as possible. We also suggest you contact the police. You can lock your card on the Trust App. On the home screen, tap "View and Manage card" and select "Lock card". For any other concerns, please contact us via: The voice call or live chat function in your Trust App Hotline at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 )

question: I am receiving push notifications for every purchase I make. How can I turn them off?
answer: - This is one feature you shouldn't (and can't) turn off. The notifications are designed to help protect your money by ensuring your card is not misused. They also help you track your expenses and manage your finances better.

question: What is Trust Key?
answer: - Trust Key is an extra step layer of security to enable you to authorise high risk or sensitive transactions through a 6-digit PIN. When setting up your Trust Key, we recommend that you choose a 6-digit PIN that's different from your login passcode. After you've set it up, there will be a 12 hour waiting period before your Trust Key is ready to use. When you make a high risk or sensitive transaction, Trust Key provides protection by verifying if the transaction was made by you through a 6-digit PIN. It is compulsory to set up Trust Key to perform high risk or sensitive banking activities that requires transaction signing. These activities include: 1. Adding a new payee 2. Transferring funds or making payments above a defined threshold or increasing your transfer limits 3. Updating personal details such as mailing address, contact number and email address

question: What are the benefits of Trust Key?
answer: - 1. Easy to use No more keying in SMS OTPs or using a physical security device to authenticate your banking transactions. 2. Safe and secure When you perform high risk or sensitive activities such as adding a new payee, Trust Key digitally signs these transactions so you'll have extra protection from potential threats.

question: How does Trust Key make my account safe?
answer: - When you make a high risk or sensitive transaction, Trust Key provides protection by verifying if the transaction was made by you through a 6-digit PIN.

question: Is it compulsory to set up Trust Key?
answer: - Yes, it is compulsory to set up Trust Key. Set it up your Trust Key to perform high risk or sensitive banking activities that requires transaction signing. These activities include: 1. Adding a new payee. 2. Transferring funds or making payments above a defined threshold or increasing your transfer limits. 3. Updating personal details such as mailing address, contact number and email address. After setting up your Trust Key, there will be a 12 hour waiting period before you can use it.

question: What happens if I don't set up Trust Key?
answer: - You won't be able to make any transactions that are high risk or sensitive activities.

question: How do I set up Trust Key?
answer: - When you login to your Trust App, you will be asked to set up your Trust Key. After setting it up, there will be a 12 hour waiting period before you can use it.

question: Why do I need to set up a PIN for my Trust Key?
answer: - The PIN provides an additional layer of security in authenticating high risk or sensitive transactions, such as adding a new payee and updating personal particulars via the Trust App.

question: How do I change my Trust Key's PIN number?
answer: - 1. Log in to your Trust App. 2. Go to "Profile" and tap "Security". 3. Tap "Change Trust Key". 4. Follow the instructions to change your PIN. Do note that there will be a 12 hour waiting period before you can use your Trust Key.

question: What if I forgot the PIN for my Trust Key?
answer: - You will be required to reset your Trust Key. 1. Log in to your Trust App. 2. Go to "Profile" and scroll to "Security". 3. Press Tap "Change Trust Key". 4. Follow the instructions to change your PIN. Do note that there will be a 12 hour waiting period before you can use your Trust Key.

question: I have entered multiple incorrect PINs and now my Trust Key is locked. What should I do?
answer: - When you log in to the Trust App, you will be asked to set up your Trust Key again. Follow the instructions below to reset your PIN: 1. Log in to your Trust App. 2. Go to "Profile" and scroll to "Security". 3. Tap "Change Trust Key". 4. Follow the instructions to change your PIN. Do note that there will be a 12 hour waiting period before you can use your Trust Key.

question: Can I register my Trust Key on multiple mobile devices?
answer: - For security reasons, your Trust Key can only be set up on one mobile device. If you set it up on a new mobile device, this will automatically disable the Trust Key on your previous device.

question: What happens to Trust Key if I lose my mobile device?
answer: - Please download the Trust App on your new device and set up the Trust Key again. This will automatically disable the Trust Key on your previous device.

question: Why am I not able to use my Trust Key immediately after setting it up?
answer: - There is a 12 hour waiting period before you can use your Trust Key.

question: What should I do if I forget my app passcode?
answer: - Tap on 'Forget Passcode' on your Trust App and follow the instructions! To make things easier and more secure for you, we recommend that you activate your facial or thumbprint recognition for authentication.

question: What if I've lost my phone or changed to a new phone?
answer: - You can regain your Trust account in a few easy steps: 1. Log in to your Trust App 2. Tap on the Singpass QR code for authentication (ensure you have the Singpass app) and authenticate your Singpass account 3. For post authentication, set up your new 6-digit passcode. After completing these steps, you will no longer be able to access your Trust account on your old device.

question: What is Kill Switch?
answer: - Kill Switch is a security feature that allows you to lock or suspend access to your Trust App if you are a victim of a suspected scam. If you did not make a transaction on your card but got charged, please raise a dispute instead by contacting us. You may reach us via: - Live chat or voice call on your Trust App - OR call us at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 )

question: What happens when Kill Switch is activated?
answer: - When Kill Switch is activated, you will NOT be able to: - Access Trust App - Make physical and digital transactions via debit/credit cards - Make AutoPay transfers to third party accounts. NOTE: Deposits into savings account and AutoPay transfers to Trust credit card(s) and Savings Pot will continue to be processed, as these are transfers within your Trust account.

question: How do I block access to my Trust App?
answer: - There are 2 ways to block access to your Trust App via Kill Switch activation. 1) You may activate your Kill Switch via Trust App, under Profile > Security > Activate Kill Switch. 2) You may also call our hotline to block access to your Trust App. After selecting your preferred language, press “1” for suspected scam or fraud to speak to our customer care agents. Alternatively, you may also contact us via voice call or leave us a message on your Trust App by following these steps. - Go to Profile > Contact us - Select “Contact Trust for urgent matters” - Select “Talk to us via app”or “Leave us a message via chat” - Select “Suspected Scam or Fraud” and start the call or chat

question: How will I know if the Kill Switch activation is successful?
answer: - Once activated, we will block access to your Trust App and debit/credit card(s). If you have a savings account, AutoPay transfers will also be blocked. However, AutoPay transfers to Trust credit card(s) and Savings Pot will be processed. Any active login session will be logged out. You will receive a SMS to confirm successful activation of Kill Switch. If you re-login to Trust App, you will see the message “Kill Switch is currently active”.

question: Will deposits or incoming transfers into savings account be suspended when Kill Switch is activated?
answer: - No, it will continue to be processed. However, please note that AutoPay transfers from your savings account to third party accounts will be suspended, except AutoPay transfers to Trust credit card(s) and Savings Pot, as these are transfers within your Trust account.

question: Will debit/credit card transactions be suspended when Kill Switch is activated?
answer: - Yes, they will be suspended. Also, all authorized and recurring transactions will be blocked. However, pending transactions on your Trust card(s) will continue to be processed.

question: How do I unlock Kill Switch and re-enable access to my Trust App?
answer: - You can unlock or re-enable access to your Trust App by calling us at +65 313-TRUST ( +65 3138 7878 ). Our customer care agents will authenticate your identity, verify that your account is safe and update our system records. This process takes 1 working day. Thereafter, you can proceed to re-enable access to your Trust App using Singpass.

question: What is Shared Responsibility Framework?
answer: - The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) and Infocomm Media Development Authority introduced the Shared Responsibility Framework (SRF) with enhanced security measures to help banks and customers fight phishing scams together and promote shared accountability. The framework applies to scams that could exploit in the following ways: - Impersonation : Scammer impersonates a legitimate entity that offers services (e.g. government organisations, banks). - Link : Customer clicks on link provided by the scammer though digital messaging platform like SMS or WhatsApp and enters the account credentials onto the fabricated platform. - Phishing : Scammer uses fraudulently obtained account credentials to take over the account and perform transactions not intended by customer.

question: I received a Suspicious Transfer Alert and no longer wish to proceed with the transfer. What should I do?
answer: - Yes. You can delete the transaction by going to Trust App > Payment > AutoPay screen. The transaction will be deleted and will not be processed. You must do so within the allotted 24 hours.

question: I received an alert that my fund transfer will be completed after 24 hours. Can I request for the transfer to be effected earlier?
answer: - As part of an industry-wide real time fraud surveillance and detection measure, transactions that may pose a higher risk of phishing scams and result in account draining are put on hold for 24-hour. This is a security measure implemented to prevent unauthorised transfer in a phishing scam. You do not need to take any further actions as the transaction will be processed after this holding period unless you choose to delete it.

question: What are the responsibilities of my bank (Responsible FI)?
answer: - As a responsible FI, our duties are set out in Section 4 of the E-Payments User Protection Guidelines. Under the Shared Responsibility Framework (SRF), we will assess if we have fulfilled the following duties, in determining the sharing of responsibility for losses from phishing scams: - Cooling-off Period : We enforce a minimum 12-hour cooling-off period after the Trust Key is activated or login from a new device, restricting high-risk activities (adding payees, increasing limits, disabling notifications, changing contact information). - Instant notifications: You will receive instant push and email notifications for all your outgoing payment transactions, so you always stay updated on all transactions. - Kill Switch : Kill switch is a security feature that allows you to block all access to your Trust App. If you suspect your mobile banking access, account and/or card(s) have been compromised, you can activate Kill Switch via Trust App under Profile > Security > Activate Kill Switch. - Enhanced systems: From 26 June 2025, we will enhance our systems to help you bank more safely. Some transactions may be paused temporarily for a period of time to protect you from potential phishing scams. When this happens, you'll receive a notification from us to review the transaction. If you do not recognise the transaction, please delete the transaction right away and not later than the allotted 24-hour period. - 24/7 Reporting Channel : We offer a 24/7 reporting channel. You can contact our customer service via Trust App or call our hotline at +65 3138 7878.

question: What are my liabilities arising from unauthorised transactions in a phishing scam?
answer: - If a loss occurs due to an unauthorised transaction in a phishing scam, Trust Bank, along with your telco company (if applicable), will conduct an investigation to determine if all our responsibilities under the SRF were met. Based on this investigation, we will determine who will bear the loss. Trust Bank is committed to fulfilling our obligations. If the investigation shows we failed to meet our responsibilities under the SRF guidelines, Trust Bank will cover the loss. If the investigation determines that Trust Bank acted in accordance with our duties, then the responsibility for the loss will be assessed according to the SRF guidelines.

question: How can I protect my money from scammers?
